<h1 id="box-platform-api">Box Platform API v2024.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

[Box Platform](https://developer.box.com) provides functionality to provide access to content stored within [Box](https://box.com). It provides endpoints for basic manipulation of files and folders, management of users within an enterprise, as well as more complex topics such as legal holds and retention policies.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://api.box.com/2.0">https://api.box.com/2.0</a> - Box Platform API server.

<a href="https://cloud.app.box.com/s/rmwxu64h1ipr41u49w3bbuvbsa29wku9">Terms of service</a>
Email: <a href="mailto:devrel@box.com">Box, Inc</a> 
Web: <a href="https://developer.box.com">Box, Inc</a> 
License: <a href="https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0">Apache-2.0</a>

<a href="https://developer.box.com">Box Developer Documentation.</a>

# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. The access token received from the authorization server in the OAuth 2.0 flow.

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://account.box.com/api/oauth2/authorize](https://account.box.com/api/oauth2/authorize)
    - Token URL = [https://api.box.com/oauth2/token](https://api.box.com/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|root_readonly|Read all files and folders stored in Box|
|root_readwrite|Read and write all files and folders stored in Box|
|manage_app_users|Provision and manage app users|
|manage_managed_users|Provision and manage managed users|
|manage_groups|Manage an enterprise's groups|
|manage_webhook|Create webhooks programmatically through the API|
|manage_enterprise_properties|Manage enterprise properties|
|manage_data_retention|Manage data retention polices|
|manage_legal_hold|Manage Legal Holds|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-ai">AI</h1>

A set of endpoints used to
interact with supported LLMs.

## Ask question

<a id="opIdpost_ai_ask"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai/ask \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "mode": "multiple_item_qa",
    "prompt": "What is the value provided by public APIs based on this document?",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "123",
        "type": "file",
        "content": "This is file content."
      }
    ],
    "dialogue_history": [
      {
        "prompt": "Make my email about public APIs sound more professional.",
        "answer": "Here is the first draft of your professional email about public APIs.",
        "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00"
      }
    ],
    "include_citations": true,
    "ai_agent": {
      "type": "ai_agent_id",
      "id": "14031"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /ai/ask`

Sends an AI request to supported LLMs and returns an answer specifically focused on the user's question given the provided context.

You can ask a question about a single file, several files, or the entire contents of a Box Hub. To search across and ask questions about everything in a Box Hub, send a single item with `type` set to `hubs` and the Hub's ID as the `id`. Box AI answers the question using the indexed content of all files in that Hub.

Asking questions about a Box Hub requires Box AI for Hubs to be enabled in the Admin Console before the Hub is created, so that its content is indexed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "mode": "multiple_item_qa",
  "prompt": "What is the value provided by public APIs based on this document?",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "123",
      "type": "file",
      "content": "This is file content."
    }
  ],
  "dialogue_history": [
    {
      "prompt": "Make my email about public APIs sound more professional.",
      "answer": "Here is the first draft of your professional email about public APIs.",
      "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00"
    }
  ],
  "include_citations": true,
  "ai_agent": {
    "type": "ai_agent_id",
    "id": "14031"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="ask-question-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AiAsk](#schemaaiask)|false|none|
|» mode|body|string|true|Box AI handles text documents with text representations up to 2MB in size, or a maximum of 25 files,<br>whichever comes first. If the text file size exceeds 2MB, the first 2MB of text representation will be processed.<br>Box AI handles image documents with a resolution of 1024 x 1024 pixels, with a maximum of 5 images or 5 pages<br>for multi-page images. If the number of image or image pages exceeds 5, the first 5 images or pages will<br>be processed. If you set mode parameter to `single_item_qa`, the items array can have one element only.<br>Currently Box AI does not support multi-modal requests. If both images and text are sent Box AI will only<br>process the text.|
|» prompt|body|string|true|The prompt provided by the client to be answered by the LLM.<br>The prompt's length is limited to 10000 characters.|
|» items|body|[[AiItemAsk](#schemaaiitemask)]|true|The items to be processed by the LLM, often files.<br>To search across and ask questions about the contents of a Box Hub,<br>pass a single item with `type` set to `hubs`. See the item `type`<br>property for details.|
|» dialogue_history|body|[[AiDialogueHistory](#schemaaidialoguehistory)]|false|The history of prompts and answers previously passed to the LLM. This provides additional context to the LLM in generating the response.|
|» include_citations|body|boolean|false|A flag to indicate whether citations should be returned.|
|» ai_agent|body|object|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentReference](#schemaaiagentreference)|false|The AI agent used to handle queries.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentAsk](#schemaaiagentask)|false|The AI agent used to handle queries.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» mode|multiple_item_qa|
|» mode|single_item_qa|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "answer": "Public APIs are important because of key and important reasons.",
  "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00",
  "completion_reason": "done",
  "ai_agent_info": {
    "models": [
      {
        "name": "azure__openai__text_embedding_ada_002",
        "provider": "azure",
        "supported_purpose": "embedding"
      }
    ],
    "processor": "basic_text"
  },
  "citations": [
    {
      "content": "Public APIs are key drivers of innovation and growth.",
      "id": "123",
      "type": "file",
      "name": "The importance of public APIs.pdf"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "type": "error",
  "status": 400,
  "code": "item_name_invalid",
  "message": "Method Not Allowed",
  "context_info": {
    "message": "Something went wrong"
  },
  "help_url": "https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/permissions-and-errors/common-errors/",
  "request_id": "abcdef123456"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "type": "error",
  "status": 400,
  "code": "item_name_invalid",
  "message": "Method Not Allowed",
  "context_info": {
    "message": "Something went wrong"
  },
  "help_url": "https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/permissions-and-errors/common-errors/",
  "request_id": "abcdef123456"
}
```

<h3 id="ask-question-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A successful response including the answer from the LLM.|[AiResponse--Full](#schemaairesponse--full)|
|204|No Content|No content is available to answer the question. This is returned when the request item is a hub, but content in the hubs is not indexed. To ensure content in the hub is indexed, make sure Box AI for Hubs in the Admin Console was enabled before hub creation.|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|An unexpected server error.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2Security
</aside>

## Generate text

<a id="opIdpost_ai_text_gen"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai/text_gen \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "Write an email to a client about the importance of public APIs.",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "123",
        "type": "file",
        "content": "This is file content that is relevant to the text gen request."
      }
    ],
    "dialogue_history": [
      {
        "prompt": "Make my email about public APIs sound more professional.",
        "answer": "Here is the first draft of your professional email about public APIs.",
        "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00"
      }
    ],
    "ai_agent": {
      "type": "ai_agent_id",
      "id": "14031"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /ai/text_gen`

Sends an AI request to supported Large Language Models (LLMs) and returns generated text based on the provided prompt.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "prompt": "Write an email to a client about the importance of public APIs.",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "123",
      "type": "file",
      "content": "This is file content that is relevant to the text gen request."
    }
  ],
  "dialogue_history": [
    {
      "prompt": "Make my email about public APIs sound more professional.",
      "answer": "Here is the first draft of your professional email about public APIs.",
      "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00"
    }
  ],
  "ai_agent": {
    "type": "ai_agent_id",
    "id": "14031"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="generate-text-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AiTextGen](#schemaaitextgen)|false|none|
|» prompt|body|string|true|The prompt provided by the client to be answered by the LLM. The prompt's length is limited to 10000 characters.|
|» items|body|[object]|true|The items to be processed by the LLM, often files.<br>The array can include **exactly one** element.<br><br>**Note**: Box AI handles documents with text representations up to 2MB in size.<br>If the file size exceeds 2MB, the first 2MB of text representation will be processed.|
|» » id|body|string|true|The ID of the item.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The type of the item.|
|» » content|body|string|false|The content to use as context for generating new text or editing existing text.|
|» dialogue_history|body|[[AiDialogueHistory](#schemaaidialoguehistory)]|false|The history of prompts and answers previously passed to the LLM. This parameter provides the additional context to the LLM when generating the response.|
|» ai_agent|body|object|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentReference](#schemaaiagentreference)|false|The AI agent used to handle queries.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentTextGen](#schemaaiagenttextgen)|false|The AI agent used for generating text.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|file|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "answer": "Public APIs are important because of key and important reasons.",
  "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00",

        "name": "azure__openai__text_embedding_ada_002",

}
```

## Get AI agent default configuration

<a id="opIdget_ai_agent_default"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.box.com/2.0/ai_agent_default?mode=ask' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai_agent_default`

Get the AI agent default config.

<h3 id="get-ai-agent-default-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|mode|query|string|true|The mode to filter the agent config to return.|
|language|query|string|false|The ISO language code to return the agent config for.<br>If the language is not supported the default agent config is returned.|
|model|query|string|false|The model to return the default agent config for.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|ask|
|mode|text_gen|
|mode|extract|
|mode|extract_structured|

## Extract metadata (freeform)

<a id="opIdpost_ai_extract"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai/extract \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "\\\"fields\\\":[{\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"key\\\":\\\"name\\\",\\\"displayName\\\":\\\"Name\\\",\\\"description\\\":\\\"The customer name\\\",\\\"prompt\\\":\\\"Name is always the first word in the document\\\"},{\\\"type\\\":\\\"date\\\",\\\"key\\\":\\\"last_contacted_at\\\",\\\"displayName\\\":\\\"Last Contacted At\\\",\\\"description\\\":\\\"When this customer was last contacted at\\\"}]",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "123",
        "type": "file",
        "content": "This is file content."
      }
    ],
    "ai_agent": {
      "type": "ai_agent_id",
      "id": "14031"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /ai/extract`

Sends an AI request to supported Large Language Models (LLMs) and extracts metadata in form of key-value pairs.
In this request, both the prompt and the output can be freeform.
Metadata template setup before sending the request is not required.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "prompt": "\\\"fields\\\":[{\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"key\\\":\\\"name\\\",\\\"displayName\\\":\\\"Name\\\",\\\"description\\\":\\\"The customer name\\\",\\\"prompt\\\":\\\"Name is always the first word in the document\\\"},{\\\"type\\\":\\\"date\\\",\\\"key\\\":\\\"last_contacted_at\\\",\\\"displayName\\\":\\\"Last Contacted At\\\",\\\"description\\\":\\\"When this customer was last contacted at\\\"}]",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "123",
      "type": "file",
      "content": "This is file content."
    }
  ],
  "ai_agent": {
    "type": "ai_agent_id",
    "id": "14031"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="extract-metadata-freeform-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AiExtract](#schemaaiextract)|false|none|
|» prompt|body|string|true|The prompt provided to a Large Language Model (LLM) in the request. The prompt can be up to 10000 characters long and it can be an XML or a JSON schema.|
|» items|body|[[AiItem--Base](#schemaaiitem--base)]|true|The items that LLM will process. Currently, you can use files only.|
|» ai_agent|body|object|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentReference](#schemaaiagentreference)|false|The AI agent used to handle queries.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentExtract](#schemaaiagentextract)|false|The AI agent to be used for extraction.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "answer": "Public APIs are important because of key and important reasons.",
  "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00",
  "completion_reason": "done",
  "ai_agent_info": {
    "models": [
      {
        "name": "azure__openai__text_embedding_ada_002",
        "provider": "azure",
        "supported_purpose": "embedding"
      }
    ],
    "processor": "basic_text"
  }
}
```

## Extract metadata (structured)

<a id="opIdpost_ai_extract_structured"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai/extract_structured \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "123",
        "type": "file",

      }
    ],

    },
    "fields": [

        "type": "enum",

          }
        ],

```

`POST /ai/extract_structured`

Sends an AI request to supported Large Language Models (LLMs) and returns extracted metadata as a set of key-value pairs.

To define the extraction structure, provide either a metadata template or a list of fields. To learn more about creating templates, see [Creating metadata templates in the Admin Console](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/360044194033-Customizing-Metadata-Templates)
or use the [metadata template API](https://developer.box.com/guides/metadata/templates/create).

This endpoint also supports [Enhanced Extract Agent](https://developer.box.com/guides/box-ai/ai-tutorials/extract-metadata-structured#enhanced-extract-agent).

For information about supported file formats and languages, see the [Extract metadata from file (structured)](https://developer.box.com/guides/box-ai/ai-tutorials/extract-metadata-structured) API guide.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "123",
      "type": "file",
      "content": "This is file content."
    }
  ],
  "metadata_template": {
    "template_key": "invoiceTemplate",
    "type": "metadata_template",
    "scope": "enterprise_12345"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "name",
      "description": "The name of the person.",
      "displayName": "Name",
      "prompt": "Name is the first and last name from the email address",
      "type": "enum",
      "options": [
        {
          "key": "First Name"
        },
        {
          "key": "Last Name"
        }
      ],
      "fields": [
        {
          "key": "street_name",
          "description": "The street name of the address.",
          "displayName": "Street Name",
          "prompt": "The street name from the address section",
          "type": "string",
          "options": [
            {
              "key": "First Name"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "taxonomy_key": "certification_taxonomy",
      "namespace": "enterprise_123",
      "options_rules": {
        "multiSelect": false,
        "selectableLevels": [
          1,
          2
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "ai_agent": {
    "type": "ai_agent_id",
    "id": "14031"
  },
  "include_confidence_score": true,
  "include_reference": true,
  "taxonomy_sources": [
    {
      "type": "taxonomy",
      "taxonomy_key": "certification_taxonomy",
      "namespace": "enterprise_123"
    },
    {
      "type": "file",
      "taxonomy_key": "industry_taxonomy",
      "id": "1234567890"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="extract-metadata-structured-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AiExtractStructured](#schemaaiextractstructured)|false|none|
|» items|body|[[AiItem--Base](#schemaaiitem--base)]|true|The items to be processed by the LLM. Currently you can use files only.|
|» metadata_template|body|object|false|The metadata template containing the fields to extract.<br>For your request to work, you must provide either `metadata_template` or `fields`, but not both.|
|» » template_key|body|string|false|The name of the metadata template.|
|» » type|body|string|false|Value is always `metadata_template`.|
|» » scope|body|string|false|The scope of the metadata template that can either be global or<br>enterprise.<br>* The **global** scope is used for templates that are<br>available to any Box enterprise.<br>* The **enterprise** scope represents templates created within a specific enterprise,<br>  containing the ID of that enterprise.|
|» fields|body|[object]|false|The fields to be extracted from the provided items.<br>For your request to work, you must provide either `metadata_template` or `fields`, but not both.|
|» » key|body|string|true|A unique identifier for the field.|
|» » description|body|string|false|A description of the field.|
|» » displayName|body|string|false|The display name of the field.|
|» » prompt|body|string|false|The context about the key that may include how to find and format it.|
|» » type|body|string|false|The type of the field. It can include but is not limited to `string`, `float`, `date`, `enum`, `multiSelect`,`taxonomy`, `struct`, and `table`.|
|» » options|body|[object]|false|A list of options for this field. This is most often used in combination with the `enum` and `multiSelect` field types.|
|» » » key|body|string|true|A unique identifier for the option.|
|» » fields|body|[[AiExtractSubField](#schemaaiextractsubfield)]|false|The nested fields for this field. Used with `struct` and `table` field types to define the nested structure.|
|» » taxonomy_key|body|string|false|The identifier for a taxonomy, which corresponds to the `key` of the taxonomy source. Required if using `taxonomy` type field.|
|» » namespace|body|string|false|The namespace of the taxonomy source. Required if using `taxonomy` type field from an existing taxonomy.|
|» » options_rules|body|object|false|none|
|» » » multi_select|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the field is a multi-select field.<br>If true, the field can have multiple values.|
|» » » selectable_levels|body|[integer]|false|The selectable levels for the field.<br>This is used to limit the levels of the taxonomy that can be selected.|
|» ai_agent|body|object|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentReference](#schemaaiagentreference)|false|The AI agent used to handle queries.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AiAgentExtractStructured](#schemaaiagentextractstructured)|false|The AI agent to be used for structured extraction.|
|» include_confidence_score|body|boolean|false|A flag to indicate whether confidence scores for every extracted field should be returned. Estimates the likelihood that an extracted metadata field value is accurate and correct. Displays a numerical and categorical confidence score to help users and automated systems quickly determine extraction reliability.|
|» include_reference|body|boolean|false|A flag to indicate whether references for every extracted field should be returned. References and bounding boxes show where the agent extracted the metadata from. They help you check for accuracy and fix any mistakes. References are short, exact quotes from the original document used to verify results. Bounding boxes highlight the specific areas on the page where that text is found.|
|» taxonomy_sources|body|[[AiTaxonomySource](#schemaaitaxonomysource)]|false|The taxonomy sources to be used for the structured extraction. They can either be an existing file or a taxonomy.<br>For your request to work, `fields` must also be provided. `taxonomy_sources` is not supported with `metadata_template`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|metadata_template|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-ai-studio">AI Studio</h1>

A set of endpoints used to
interact with AI Studio.

## List AI agents

<a id="opIdget_ai_agents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai_agents \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai_agents`

Lists AI agents based on the provided parameters.

<h3 id="list-ai-agents-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|mode|query|[string]|false|The mode to filter the agent config to return. Possible values are: `ask`, `text_gen`, and `extract`.|
|fields|query|[string]|false|The fields to return in the response.|
|agent_state|query|[string]|false|The state of the agents to return. Possible values are: `enabled`, `disabled` and `enabled_for_selected_users`.|
|include_box_default|query|boolean|false|Whether to include the Box default agents in the response.|
|marker|query|string|false|Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|

## Create AI agent

<a id="opIdpost_ai_agents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai_agents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "type": "ai_agent",
    "name": "My AI Agent",
    "access_state": "enabled",
    "icon_reference": "https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/logo_analytics.svg",
    "allowed_entities": [
      {
        "id": "11446498",
        "type": "user"
      }
    ],
    "ask": {
      "type": "ai_agent_ask",
      "access_state": "enabled",
      "description": "This is ASK Agent",
      "custom_instructions": "This is a custom instruction",
      "suggested_questions": [
        "What is in this file?",
        "What are the main highlights of this document?"
      ],
      "long_text": {
        "model": "azure__openai__gpt_4o_mini",
        "num_tokens_for_completion": 8400,
        "llm_endpoint_params": {
          "type": "openai_params",
          "temperature": 0,
          "top_p": 1,
          "frequency_penalty": 1.5,
          "presence_penalty": 1.5,
          "stop": "<|im_end|>"
        },
        "system_message": "You are a helpful travel assistant specialized in budget travel",
        "prompt_template": "It is `{current_date}`, consider these travel options `{content}` and answer the `{user_question}`.",
        "embeddings": {
          "model": "azure__openai__text_embedding_ada_002",
          "strategy": {
            "id": "basic",
            "num_tokens_per_chunk": 64
          }
        },
        "is_custom_instructions_included": false
      },
      "basic_text": {
        "model": "azure__openai__gpt_4o_mini",
        "num_tokens_for_completion": 8400,
```

`POST /ai_agents`

Creates an AI agent. At least one of the following capabilities must be provided: `ask`, `text_gen`, `extract`.

<h3 id="create-ai-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateAiAgent](#schemacreateaiagent)|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of agent used to handle queries.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the AI Agent.|
|» access_state|body|string|true|The state of the AI Agent. Possible values are: `enabled`, `disabled`, and `enabled_for_selected_users`.|
|» icon_reference|body|string|false|The icon reference of the AI Agent. It should have format of the URL `https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/<file_name>`<br>where possible values of `file_name` are: `logo_boxAi.png`,`logo_stamp.png`,`logo_legal.png`,`logo_finance.png`,`logo_config.png`,`logo_handshake.png`,`logo_analytics.png`,`logo_classification.png`.|
|» allowed_entities|body|[[AiAgentAllowedEntity](#schemaaiagentallowedentity)]|false|List of allowed users or groups.|
|» ask|body|[AiStudioAgentAsk](#schemaaistudioagentask)|false|The AI agent to be used to handle queries.|
|» text_gen|body|[AiStudioAgentTextGen](#schemaaistudioagenttextgen)|false|The AI agent to be used to generate text.|
|» extract|body|[AiStudioAgentExtract](#schemaaistudioagentextract)|false|The AI agent to be used for metadata extraction.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|ai_agent|

## Get AI agent by agent ID

<a id="opIdget_ai_agents_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai_agents/1234 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai_agents/{agent_id}`

Gets an AI Agent using the `agent_id` parameter.

<h3 id="get-ai-agent-by-agent-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agent_id|path|string|true|The agent id to get.|
|fields|query|[string]|false|The fields to return in the response.|


<h3 id="update-ai-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agent_id|path|string|true|The ID of the agent to update.|
|body|body|[CreateAiAgent](#schemacreateaiagent)|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of agent used to handle queries.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the AI Agent.|
|» access_state|body|string|true|The state of the AI Agent. Possible values are: `enabled`, `disabled`, and `enabled_for_selected_users`.|
|» icon_reference|body|string|false|The icon reference of the AI Agent. It should have format of the URL `https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/<file_name>`<br>where possible values of `file_name` are: `logo_boxAi.png`,`logo_stamp.png`,`logo_legal.png`,`logo_finance.png`,`logo_config.png`,`logo_handshake.png`,`logo_analytics.png`,`logo_classification.png`.|
|» allowed_entities|body|[[AiAgentAllowedEntity](#schemaaiagentallowedentity)]|false|List of allowed users or groups.|
|» ask|body|[AiStudioAgentAsk](#schemaaistudioagentask)|false|The AI agent to be used to handle queries.|
|» text_gen|body|[AiStudioAgentTextGen](#schemaaistudioagenttextgen)|false|The AI agent to be used to generate text.|
|» extract|body|[AiStudioAgentExtract](#schemaaistudioagentextract)|false|The AI agent to be used for metadata extraction.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|ai_agent|

## Delete AI agent

<a id="opIddelete_ai_agents_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/ai_agents/1234 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /ai_agents/{agent_id}`

Deletes an AI agent using the provided parameters.

<h3 id="delete-ai-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agent_id|path|string|true|The ID of the agent to delete.|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-app-item-associations">App item associations</h1>

## List file app item associations

<a id="opIdget_files_id_app_item_associations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/files/12345/app_item_associations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /files/{file_id}/app_item_associations`

**This is a beta feature, which means that its availability might be limited.**
Returns all app items the file is associated with. This includes app items
associated with ancestors of the file. Assuming the context user has access
to the file, the type/ids are revealed even if the context user does not
have **View** permission on the app item.

<h3 id="list-file-app-item-associations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier that represents a file.<br><br>The ID for any file can be determined<br>by visiting a file in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123`<br>the `file_id` is `123`.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|marker|query|string|false|Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is<br>used when paginating using marker-based pagination.<br><br>This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.|
|application_type|query|string|false|If given, only return app items for this application type.|

```json
  "next_marker": "JV9IRGZmieiBasejOG9yDCRNgd2ymoZIbjsxbJMjIs3kioVii",
```

## List folder app item associations

<a id="opIdget_folders_id_app_item_associations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/folders/12345/app_item_associations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /folders/{folder_id}/app_item_associations`

**This is a beta feature, which means that its availability might be limited.**
Returns all app items the folder is associated with. This includes app items
associated with ancestors of the folder. Assuming the context user has access
to the folder, the type/ids are revealed even if the context user does not
have **View** permission on the app item.

<h3 id="list-folder-app-item-associations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|folder_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier that represent a folder.<br><br>The ID for any folder can be determined<br>by visiting this folder in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123`<br>the `folder_id` is `123`.<br><br>The root folder of a Box account is<br>always represented by the ID `0`.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|marker|query|string|false|Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is<br>used when paginating using marker-based pagination.<br><br>This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.|
|application_type|query|string|false|If given, returns only app items for this application type.|

```json
  },
```

<h1 id="box-platform-api-authorization">Authorization</h1>

A set of endpoints used to
manage user authorization process.

## Authorize user

<a id="opIdget_authorize"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.box.com/2.0/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=ly1nj6n11vionaie65emwzk575hnnmrk'
```

`GET /authorize`

Authorize a user by sending them through the [Box](https://box.com)
website and request their permission to act on their behalf.

This is the first step when authenticating a user using
OAuth 2.0. To request a user's authorization to use the Box APIs
on their behalf you will need to send a user to the URL with this
format.

<h3 id="authorize-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|response_type|query|string(token)|true|The type of response we'd like to receive.|
|client_id|query|string|true|The Client ID of the application that is requesting to authenticate<br>the user. To get the Client ID for your application, log in to your<br>Box developer console and click the **Edit Application** link for<br>the application you're working with. In the OAuth 2.0 Parameters section<br>of the configuration page, find the item labelled `client_id`. The<br>text of that item is your application's Client ID.|
|redirect_uri|query|string(url)|false|The URI to which Box redirects the browser after the user has granted<br>or denied the application permission. This URI match one of the redirect<br>URIs in the configuration of your application. It must be a<br>valid HTTPS URI and it needs to be able to handle the redirection to<br>complete the next step in the OAuth 2.0 flow.<br>Although this parameter is optional, it must be a part of the<br>authorization URL if you configured multiple redirect URIs<br>for the application in the developer console. A missing parameter causes<br>a `redirect_uri_missing` error after the user grants application access.|
|state|query|string|false|A custom string of your choice. Box will pass the same string to<br>the redirect URL when authentication is complete. This parameter<br>can be used to identify a user on redirect, as well as protect<br>against hijacked sessions and other exploits.|
|scope|query|string|false|A space-separated list of application scopes you'd like to<br>authenticate the user for. This defaults to all the scopes configured<br>for the application in its configuration page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|response_type|code|

<h3 id="authorize-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Does not return any data, but rather should be used in the browser.|Inline|
|default|Default|Does not return any data, but rather should be used in the browser.|Inline|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Request access token

<a id="opIdpost_oauth2_token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/oauth2/token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&client_id=ly1nj6n11vionaie65emwzk575hnnmrk&client_secret=hOzsTeFlT6ko0dme22uGbQal04SBPYc1&code=n22JPxrh18m4Y0wIZPIqYZK7VRrsMTWW&refresh_token=c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ&assertion=xxxxx.yyyyy.zzzzz&subject_token=c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ&subject_token_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Atoken-type%3Aaccess_token&actor_token=c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ&actor_token_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Atoken-type%3Aid_token&scope=item_upload%20item_preview%20base_explorer&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.box.com%2F2.0%2Ffiles%2F123456&box_subject_type=enterprise&box_subject_id=123456789&box_shared_link=https%3A%2F%2Fcloud.box.com%2Fs%2F123456'
```

`POST /oauth2/token`

Request an Access Token using either a client-side obtained OAuth 2.0
authorization code or a server-side JWT assertion.

An Access Token is a string that enables Box to verify that a
request belongs to an authorized session. In the normal order of
operations you will begin by requesting authentication from the
[authorize](https://developer.box.com/reference/get-authorize) endpoint and Box will send you an
authorization code.

You will then send this code to this endpoint to exchange it for
an Access Token. The returned Access Token can then be used to to make
Box API calls.

> Body parameter

```yaml
grant_type: authorization_code
client_id: ly1nj6n11vionaie65emwzk575hnnmrk
client_secret: hOzsTeFlT6ko0dme22uGbQal04SBPYc1
code: n22JPxrh18m4Y0wIZPIqYZK7VRrsMTWW
refresh_token: c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ
assertion: xxxxx.yyyyy.zzzzz
subject_token: c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ
subject_token_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token"
actor_token: c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ
actor_token_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token"
scope: item_upload item_preview base_explorer
resource: "https://api.box.com/2.0/files/123456"
box_subject_type: enterprise
box_subject_id: "123456789"
box_shared_link: "https://cloud.box.com/s/123456"
```

<h3 id="request-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PostOAuth2Token](#schemapostoauth2token)|false|none|
|» grant_type|body|string(urn)|true|The type of request being made, either using a client-side obtained<br>authorization code, a refresh token, a JWT assertion, client credentials<br>grant or another access token for the purpose of downscoping a token.|
|» client_id|body|string|false|The Client ID of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|» client_secret|body|string|false|The client secret of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|» code|body|string(token)|false|The client-side authorization code passed to your application by<br>Box in the browser redirect after the user has successfully<br>granted your application permission to make API calls on their<br>behalf.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code` as the `grant_type`.|
|» refresh_token|body|string(token)|false|A refresh token used to get a new access token with.<br><br>Used in combination with `refresh_token` as the `grant_type`.|
|» assertion|body|string(jwt)|false|A JWT assertion for which to request a new access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|» subject_token|body|string(token)|false|The token to exchange for a downscoped token. This can be a regular<br>access token, a JWT assertion, or an app token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|» subject_token_type|body|string|false|The type of `subject_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|» actor_token|body|string(token)|false|The token used to create an annotator token.<br>This is a JWT assertion.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|» actor_token_type|body|string(urn)|false|The type of `actor_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|» scope|body|string(space_delimited_list)|false|The space-delimited list of scopes that you want apply to the<br>new access token.<br><br>The `subject_token` will need to have all of these scopes or<br>the call will error with **401 Unauthorized**..|
|» resource|body|string(url)|false|Full URL for the file that the token should be generated for.|
|» box_subject_type|body|string|false|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.|
|» box_subject_id|body|string|false|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.<br>Value is determined by `box_subject_type`. If `user` use user ID and if<br>`enterprise` use enterprise ID.|
|» box_shared_link|body|string(url)|false|Full URL of the shared link on the file or folder<br>that the token should be generated for.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» grant_type|authorization_code|
|» grant_type|refresh_token|
|» grant_type|client_credentials|
|» grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer|
|» grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange|
|» subject_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token|
|» actor_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token|
|» box_subject_type|enterprise|
|» box_subject_type|user|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "access_token": "c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ",
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "restricted_to": [
    {
      "scope": "item_download",
      "object": {
        "id": "12345",
        "etag": "1",
        "type": "folder",
        "sequence_id": {},
        "name": "Contracts"
      }
    }
  ],
  "refresh_token": "c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ",
  "issued_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "invalid_client",
  "error_description": "The client credentials are not valid"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "error": "invalid_client",
  "error_description": "The client credentials are not valid"
}
```

<h3 id="request-access-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns a new Access Token that can be used to make authenticated<br>API calls by passing along the token in a authorization header as<br>follows `Authorization: Bearer <Token>`.|[AccessToken](#schemaaccesstoken)|
|400|Bad Request|An authentication error.|[OAuth2Error](#schemaoauth2error)|
|default|Default|An authentication error.|[OAuth2Error](#schemaoauth2error)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Revoke access token

<a id="opIdpost_oauth2_revoke"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/oauth2/revoke \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'client_id=ly1nj6n11vionaie65emwzk575hnnmrk&client_secret=hOzsTeFlT6ko0dme22uGbQal04SBPYc1&token=n22JPxrh18m4Y0wIZPIqYZK7VRrsMTWW'
```

`POST /oauth2/revoke`

Revoke an active Access Token, effectively logging a user out
that has been previously authenticated.

> Body parameter

```yaml
client_id: ly1nj6n11vionaie65emwzk575hnnmrk
client_secret: hOzsTeFlT6ko0dme22uGbQal04SBPYc1
token: n22JPxrh18m4Y0wIZPIqYZK7VRrsMTWW
```

<h3 id="revoke-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PostOAuth2Revoke](#schemapostoauth2revoke)|false|none|
|» client_id|body|string|false|The Client ID of the application requesting to revoke the<br>access token.|
|» client_secret|body|string|false|The client secret of the application requesting to revoke<br>an access token.|
|» token|body|string(token)|false|The access token to revoke.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "invalid_client",
  "error_description": "The client credentials are not valid"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "error": "invalid_client",
  "error_description": "The client credentials are not valid"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|default|Default|An authentication error.|[OAuth2Error](#schemaoauth2error)|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-box-sign-requests">Box Sign requests</h1>

Box Sign requests are used
to submit a file for
signature.

## Cancel Box Sign request

<a id="opIdpost_sign_requests_id_cancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/sign_requests/33243242/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "reason": "Project cancelled"
  }'
```

`POST /sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/cancel`

Cancels a sign request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "reason": "Project cancelled"
}
```

<h3 id="cancel-box-sign-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sign_request_id|path|string|true|The ID of the signature request.|
|body|body|[SignRequestCancelRequest](#schemasignrequestcancelrequest)|false|none|
|» reason|body|string|false|An optional reason for cancelling the sign request.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "is_document_preparation_needed": true,
  "redirect_url": "https://www.example.com",
  "declined_redirect_url": "https://declined-redirect.com",
  "are_text_signatures_enabled": true,
  "email_subject": "Sign Request from Acme",
  "email_message": "Hello! Please sign the document below",
  "are_reminders_enabled": true,
  "name": "name",
  "prefill_tags": [
    {
      "document_tag_id": "1234",
```

## Resend Box Sign request

<a id="opIdpost_sign_requests_id_resend"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/sign_requests/33243242/resend \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /sign_requests/{sign_request_id}/resend`

## List Box Sign requests

<a id="opIdget_sign_requests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/sign_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /sign_requests`

Gets signature requests created by a user. If the `sign_files` and/or
`parent_folder` are deleted, the signature request will not return in the list.

<h3 id="list-box-sign-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|marker|query|string|false|Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is<br>used when paginating using marker-based pagination.<br><br>This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|senders|query|[string]|false|A list of sender emails to filter the signature requests by sender.<br>If provided, `shared_requests` must be set to `true`.|
|shared_requests|query|boolean|false|If set to `true`, only includes requests that user is not an owner,<br>but user is a collaborator. Collaborator access is determined by the<br>user access level of the sign files of the request.<br>Default is `false`. Must be set to `true` if `senders` are provided.|

## Create Box Sign request

<a id="opIdpost_sign_requests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/sign_requests \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "is_document_preparation_needed": true,
    "redirect_url": "https://www.example.com",
    "declined_redirect_url": "https://declined-redirect.com",
    "are_text_signatures_enabled": true,

    "days_valid": 2,

    "template_id": "123075213-af2c8822-3ef2-4952-8557-52d69c2fe9cb",
    "external_system_name": "Box",
    "request_flow": "standard",
    "source_files": [
      {
        "id": "12345",
        "etag": "1",
        "type": "file"
      }
    ],
    "signature_color": "blue",
    "signers": [
      {
        "email": "example@gmail.com",
        "role": "signer",
        "is_in_person": true,
        "order": 2,
        "embed_url_external_user_id": "1234",
        "redirect_url": "https://example.com",
        "declined_redirect_url": "https://declined-example.com",
        "login_required": true,
        "verification_phone_number": "6314578901",
        "password": "SecretPassword123",

        "language": "en"

      "id": "12345",
      "etag": "1",
      "type": "folder",
      "sequence_id": {},
      "name": "Contracts"
    }
  }'
```

<h3 id="create-box-sign-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SignRequestCreateRequest](#schemasignrequestcreaterequest)|false|none|
|» is_document_preparation_needed|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the sender should receive a `prepare_url` in the response to complete document preparation using the UI.|
|» redirect_url|body|string \| null|false|When specified, the signature request will be redirected to this url when a document is signed.|
|» declined_redirect_url|body|string \| null|false|The uri that a signer will be redirected to after declining to sign a document.|
|» are_text_signatures_enabled|body|boolean|false|Disables the usage of signatures generated by typing (text).|
|» email_subject|body|string \| null|false|Subject of sign request email. This is cleaned by sign request. If this field is not passed, a default subject will be used.|
|» email_message|body|string \| null|false|Message to include in sign request email. The field is cleaned through sanitization of specific characters. However, some html tags are allowed. Links included in the message are also converted to hyperlinks in the email. The message may contain the following html tags including `a`, `abbr`, `acronym`, `b`, `blockquote`, `code`, `em`, `i`, `ul`, `li`, `ol`, and `strong`. Be aware that when the text to html ratio is too high, the email may end up in spam filters. Custom styles on these tags are not allowed. If this field is not passed, a default message will be used.|
|» are_reminders_enabled|body|boolean|false|Reminds signers to sign a document on day 3, 8, 13 and 18. Reminders are only sent to outstanding signers.|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the signature request.|
|» prefill_tags|body|[[SignRequestPrefillTag](#schemasignrequestprefilltag)]|false|When a document contains sign-related tags in the content, you can prefill them using this `prefill_tags` by referencing the 'id' of the tag as the `external_id` field of the prefill tag.|
|» days_valid|body|integer \| null|false|Set the number of days after which the created signature request will automatically expire if not completed. By default, we do not apply any expiration date on signature requests, and the signature request does not expire.|
|» external_id|body|string \| null|false|This can be used to reference an ID in an external system that the sign request is related to.|
|» template_id|body|string \| null|false|When a signature request is created from a template this field will indicate the id of that template.|
|» external_system_name|body|string \| null|false|Used as an optional system name to appear in the signature log next to the signers who have been assigned the `embed_url_external_id`.|
|» request_flow|body|string \| null|false|The flow type of the sign request. Values can include `standard` or `cfr11`.<br>When not specified during creation, a default is chosen based on admin settings.|
|» source_files|body|[[File--Base](#schemafile--base)]|false|List of files to create a signing document from. This is currently limited to ten files. Only the ID and type fields are required for each file.|
|» signature_color|body|string \| null|false|Force a specific color for the signature (blue, black, or red).|
|» signers|body|[[SignRequestCreateSigner](#schemasignrequestcreatesigner)]|true|Array of signers for the signature request. 35 is the<br>max number of signers permitted.<br><br>**Note**: It may happen that some signers belong to conflicting [segments](https://developer.box.com/reference/resources/shield-information-barrier-segment-member) (user groups).<br>This means that due to the security policies, users are assigned to segments to prevent exchanges or communication that could lead to ethical conflicts.<br>In such a case, an attempt to send the sign request will result in an error.<br><br>Read more about [segments and ethical walls](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/9920431507603-Understanding-Information-Barriers#h_01GFVJEHQA06N7XEZ4GCZ9GFAQ).|
|» parent_folder|body|object|false|none|
|» » id|body|string|true|The unique identifier that represent a folder.<br><br>The ID for any folder can be determined<br>by visiting a folder in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folders/123`<br>the `folder_id` is `123`.|
|» » etag|body|string \| null|false|The HTTP `etag` of this folder. This can be used within some API<br>endpoints in the `If-Match` and `If-None-Match` headers to only<br>perform changes on the folder if (no) changes have happened.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The value will always be `folder`.|
|» » sequence_id|body|object|false|none|
|» » name|body|string|false|The name of the folder.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» signature_color|blue|
|» signature_color|black|
|» signature_color|red|
|» » type|folder|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-classifications">Classifications</h1>

Classification labels are
used for content that is
sensitive or under security
restrictions.

## Add classification

<a id="opIdput_metadata_templates_enterprise_securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo_schema#add"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.box.com/2.0/metadata_templates/enterprise/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo/schema#add' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '[
    {
      "op": "addEnumOption",
      "fieldKey": "Box__Security__Classification__Key",
      "data": {
        "key": "Sensitive",
        "staticConfig": {
          "classification": {
            "classificationDefinition": "Sensitive information that must not be shared.",
            "colorID": 4
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]'
```

`PUT /metadata_templates/enterprise/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo/schema#add`

Adds one or more new classifications to the list of classifications
available to the enterprise.

This API can also be called by including the enterprise ID in the
URL explicitly, for example
`/metadata_templates/enterprise_12345/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo/schema`.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "op": "addEnumOption",
    "fieldKey": "Box__Security__Classification__Key",
    "data": {
      "key": "Sensitive",
      "staticConfig": {
        "classification": {
          "classificationDefinition": "Sensitive information that must not be shared.",
          "colorID": 4
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

`POST /metadata_templates/schema#classifications`

When an enterprise does not yet have any classifications, this API call
initializes the classification template with an initial set of
classifications.

If an enterprise already has a classification, the template will already
exist and instead an API call should be made to add additional
classifications.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "scope": "enterprise",
  "templateKey": "securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo",
  "displayName": "Classification",
  "hidden": false,
  "copyInstanceOnItemCopy": false,
  "fields": [
    {
      "type": "enum",
      "key": "Box__Security__Classification__Key",
      "displayName": "Classification",
      "hidden": false,
      "options": [
        {
          "key": "Sensitive",
          "staticConfig": {
            "classification": {
              "classificationDefinition": "Sensitive information",
              "colorID": 4
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-initial-classifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» scope|body|string|true|The scope in which to create the classifications. This should<br>be `enterprise` or `enterprise_{id}` where `id` is the unique<br>ID of the enterprise.|
|» templateKey|body|string|true|Defines the list of metadata templates.|
|» displayName|body|string|true|The name of the<br>template as shown in web and mobile interfaces.|
|» hidden|body|boolean|false|Determines if the classification template is<br>hidden or available on web and mobile<br>devices.|
|» copyInstanceOnItemCopy|body|boolean|false|Determines if classifications are<br>copied along when the file or folder is<br>copied.|
|» fields|body|[object]|true|The classification template requires exactly<br>one field, which holds<br>all the valid classification values.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The type of the field<br>that is always enum.|
|» » key|body|string|true|Defines classifications <br>available in the enterprise.|
|» » displayName|body|string|true|A display name for the classification.|
|» » hidden|body|boolean|false|Determines if the classification<br>template is<br>hidden or available on<br>web and mobile<br>devices.|
|» » options|body|[object]|true|The actual list of classifications that are present on<br>this template.|
|» » » key|body|string|true|The display name and key this classification. This<br>will be show in the Box UI.|
|» » » staticConfig|body|object|false|Additional information about the classification.|
|» » » » classification|body|object|false|Additional information about the classification.|
|» » » » » classificationDefinition|body|string|false|A longer description of the classification.|
|» » » » » colorID|body|integer(int64)|false|An identifier used to assign a color to<br>a classification label.<br><br>Mapping between a `colorID` and a color may<br>change without notice. Currently, the color<br>mappings are as follows.<br><br>* `0`: Yellow.<br>* `1`: Orange.<br>* `2`: Watermelon red.<br>* `3`: Purple rain.<br>* `4`: Light blue.<br>* `5`: Dark blue.<br>* `6`: Light green.<br>* `7`: Gray.|

|» templateKey|securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo|
|» displayName|Classification|
|» » type|enum|
|» » key|Box__Security__Classification__Key|
|» » displayName|Classification|

## Update classification on file

`PUT /files/{file_id}/metadata/enterprise/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo`

Updates a classification on a file.

The classification can only be updated if a classification has already been
applied to the file before. When editing classifications, only values are
defined for the enterprise will be accepted.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "op": "replace",
    "path": "/Box__Security__Classification__Key",
    "value": "Sensitive"
  }
]
```

|body|body|[object]|false|none|
|» op|body|string|true|The value will always be `replace`.|
|» path|body|string|true|Defines classifications<br>available in the enterprise.|
|» value|body|string|true|The name of the classification to apply to this file.<br><br>To list the available classifications in an enterprise,<br>use the classification API to retrieve the<br>[classification template](https://developer.box.com/reference/get-metadata-templates-enterprise-securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo-schema)<br>which lists all available classification keys.|

`PUT /folders/{folder_id}/metadata/enterprise/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo`

defined for the enterprise will be accepted.

<h1 id="box-platform-api-collaborations">Collaborations</h1>

## Update collaboration

<a id="opIdput_collaborations_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/collaborations/1234 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "role": "editor",
    "status": "accepted",
    "expires_at": "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00",
    "can_view_path": true
  }'
```

`PUT /collaborations/{collaboration_id}`

Updates a collaboration.
Can be used to change the owner of an item, or to
accept collaboration invites. In case of accepting collaboration invite, role is not required.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "role": "editor",
  "status": "accepted",
  "expires_at": "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00",
  "can_view_path": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-collaboration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|collaboration_id|path|string|true|The ID of the collaboration.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» role|body|string|false|The level of access granted.|
|» status|body|string|false|Set the status of a `pending` collaboration invitation,<br>effectively accepting, or rejecting the invite.|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time)|false|Update the expiration date for the collaboration. At this date,<br>the collaboration will be automatically removed from the item.<br><br>This feature will only work if the **Automatically remove invited<br>collaborators: Allow folder owners to extend the expiry date**<br>setting has been enabled in the **Enterprise Settings**<br>of the **Admin Console**. When the setting is not enabled,<br>collaborations can not have an expiry date and a value for this<br>field will be result in an error.<br><br>Additionally, a collaboration can only be given an<br>expiration if it was created after the **Automatically remove<br>invited collaborator** setting was enabled.|
|» can_view_path|body|boolean|false|Determines if the invited users can see the entire parent path to<br>the associated folder. The user will not gain privileges in any<br>parent folder and therefore can not see content the user is not<br>collaborated on.<br><br>Be aware that this meaningfully increases the time required to load the<br>invitee's **All Files** page. We recommend you limit the number of<br>collaborations with `can_view_path` enabled to 1,000 per user.<br><br>Only an owner or co-owners can invite collaborators with a `can_view_path` of<br>`true`. Only an owner can update `can_view_path` on existing collaborations.<br><br>`can_view_path` can only be used for folder collaborations.<br><br>When you delete a folder with `can_view_path=true`, collaborators may still see the parent path. <br>For instructions on how to remove this, see <br>[Even though a folder invited via can_view_path is deleted, the path remains displayed](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/37472814319891-Even-though-a-folder-invited-via-can-view-path-is-deleted-the-path-remains-displayed).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» role|editor|
|» role|viewer|
|» role|previewer|
|» role|uploader|
|» role|previewer uploader|

## Create collaboration

<a id="opIdpost_collaborations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/collaborations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "item": {
      "type": "file",
      "id": "11446498"
    },
    "accessible_by": {
      "type": "user",
      "id": "23522323",
      "login": "john@example.com"
    },
    "role": "editor",
    "is_access_only": true,
    "can_view_path": true,
    "expires_at": "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00"
  }'
```

`POST /collaborations`

Adds a collaboration for a single user or a single group to a file
or folder.

Collaborations can be created using email address, user IDs, or a
group IDs.

If a collaboration is being created with a group, access to
this endpoint is dependent on the group's ability to be invited.

If collaboration is in `pending` status, field `name` is redacted when:
- a collaboration was created using `user_id`,
- a collaboration was created using `login`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "item": {
    "type": "file",
    "id": "11446498"
  },
  "accessible_by": {
    "type": "user",
    "id": "23522323",
    "login": "john@example.com"
  },
  "role": "editor",
  "is_access_only": true,
  "can_view_path": true,
  "expires_at": "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00"
}
```

<h3 id="create-collaboration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fields|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the<br>response. This can be used to request fields that are<br>not normally returned in a standard response.<br><br>Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the<br>effect that none of the standard fields are returned in<br>the response unless explicitly specified, instead only<br>fields for the mini representation are returned, additional<br>to the fields requested.|
|notify|query|boolean|false|Determines if users should receive email notification<br>for the action performed.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» item|body|object|true|The item to attach the comment to.|
|» » type|body|string|false|The type of the item that this collaboration will be<br>granted access to.|
|» » id|body|string|false|The ID of the item that will be granted access to.|
|» accessible_by|body|object|true|The user or group to give access to the item.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The type of collaborator to invite.|
|» » id|body|string|false|The ID of the user or group.<br><br>Alternatively, use `login` to specify a user by email<br>address.|
|» » login|body|string|false|The email address of the user to grant access to the item.<br><br>Alternatively, use `id` to specify a user by user ID.|
|» role|body|string|true|The level of access granted.|
|» is_access_only|body|boolean|false|If set to `true`, collaborators have access to<br>shared items, but such items won't be visible in the<br>All Files list. Additionally, collaborators won't<br>see the path to the root folder for the<br>shared item.|
|» can_view_path|body|boolean|false|Determines if the invited users can see the entire parent path to<br>the associated folder. The user will not gain privileges in any<br>parent folder and therefore can not see content the user is not<br>collaborated on.<br><br>Be aware that this meaningfully increases the time required to load the<br>invitee's **All Files** page. We recommend you limit the number of<br>collaborations with `can_view_path` enabled to 1,000 per user.<br><br>Only an owner or co-owners can invite collaborators with a `can_view_path` of<br>`true`. Only an owner can update `can_view_path` on existing collaborations.<br><br>`can_view_path` can only be used for folder collaborations.<br><br>When you delete a folder with `can_view_path=true`, collaborators may still see the parent path. <br>For instructions on how to remove this, see <br>[Even though a folder invited via can_view_path is deleted, the path remains displayed](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/37472814319891-Even-though-a-folder-invited-via-can-view-path-is-deleted-the-path-remains-displayed).|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time)|false|Set the expiration date for the collaboration. At this date, the<br>collaboration will be automatically removed from the item.<br><br>This feature will only work if the **Automatically remove invited<br>collaborators: Allow folder owners to extend the expiry date**<br>setting has been enabled in the **Enterprise Settings**<br>of the **Admin Console**. When the setting is not enabled,<br>collaborations can not have an expiry date and a value for this<br>field will be result in an error.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|file|
|» » type|folder|
|» » type|user|
|» » type|group|
|» role|editor|
|» role|viewer|
|» role|previewer|
|» role|uploader|
|» role|previewer uploader|
|» role|viewer uploader|
|» role|co-owner|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-collaborations-list">Collaborations (List)</h1>

## List file collaborations

<a id="opIdget_files_id_collaborations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/files/12345/collaborations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /files/{file_id}/collaborations`

Retrieves a list of pending and active collaborations for a
file. This returns all the users that have access to the file
or have been invited to the file.

<h3 id="list-file-collaborations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|fields|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the<br>response. This can be used to request fields that are<br>not normally returned in a standard response.<br><br>Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the<br>effect that none of the standard fields are returned in<br>the response unless explicitly specified, instead only<br>fields for the mini representation are returned, additional<br>to the fields requested.|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|marker|query|string|false|Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is<br>used when paginating using marker-based pagination.<br><br>This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.|

## List pending collaborations

<a id="opIdget_collaborations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.box.com/2.0/collaborations?status=pending' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /collaborations`

Retrieves all pending collaboration invites for this user.

<h3 id="list-pending-collaborations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|true|The status of the collaborations to retrieve.|

## List group collaborations

<h1 id="box-platform-api-collections">Collections</h1>

Collections are a way to group files,
folders, and web links without putting them
all into a folder.

## List all collections

<a id="opIdget_collections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|

<h1 id="box-platform-api-comments">Comments</h1>

Comments are messages generated users on files,
allowing users to collaborate on a file,
discussing any feedback they might
have on the content.

## List file comments

<a id="opIdget_files_id_comments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/files/12345/comments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /files/{file_id}/comments`

Retrieves a list of comments for a file.

|fields|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the<br>response. This can be used to request fields that are<br>not normally returned in a standard response.<br><br>Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the<br>effect that none of the standard fields are returned in<br>the response unless explicitly specified, instead only<br>fields for the mini representation are returned, additional<br>to the fields requested.|

|offset|query|integer(int64)|false|The offset of the item at which to begin the response.<br><br>Queries with offset parameter value<br>exceeding 10000 will be rejected<br>with a 400 response.|

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/comments \
```

`POST /comments`

Adds a comment by the user to a specific file, or
as a reply to an other comment.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "Review completed!",
  "tagged_message": "@[1234:John] Review completed!",
  "item": {
    "id": "11446498",
    "type": "file"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-comment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fields|query|[string]|false|A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the<br>response. This can be used to request fields that are<br>not normally returned in a standard response.<br><br>Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the<br>effect that none of the standard fields are returned in<br>the response unless explicitly specified, instead only<br>fields for the mini representation are returned, additional<br>to the fields requested.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» message|body|string|true|The text of the comment.<br><br>To mention a user, use the `tagged_message`<br>parameter instead.|
|» tagged_message|body|string|false|The text of the comment, including `@[user_id:name]`<br>somewhere in the message to mention another user, which<br>will send them an email notification, letting them know<br>they have been mentioned.<br><br>The `user_id` is the target user's ID, where the `name`<br>can be any custom phrase. In the Box UI this name will<br>link to the user's profile.<br><br>If you are not mentioning another user, use `message`<br>instead.|
|» item|body|object|true|The item to attach the comment to.|
|» » id|body|string|true|The ID of the item.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The type of the item that this comment will be placed on.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|file|
|» » type|comment|

```json
  "item": {

    "type": "file"
  },
  "tagged_message": "@[1234567:Aaron Levie] these tigers are cool!"
}
```

<h1 id="box-platform-api-downloads">Downloads</h1>

Downloads allow saving files to the application's server,
or directly by the end user in a browser.

## Download file

<a id="opIdget_files_id_content"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.box.com/2.0/files/12345/content \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /files/{file_id}/content`

Returns the contents of a file in binary format.

<h3 id="download-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier that represents a file.<br><br>The ID for any file can be determined<br>by visiting a file in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123`<br>the `file_id` is `123`.|
|range|header|string|false|The byte range of the content to download.<br><br>The format `bytes={start_byte}-{end_byte}` can be used to specify<br>what section of the file to download.|
|boxapi|header|string|false|The URL, and optional password, for the shared link of this item.<br><br>This header can be used to access items that have not been<br>explicitly shared with a user.<br><br>Use the format `shared_link=[link]` or if a password is required then<br>use `shared_link=[link]&shared_link_password=[password]`.<br><br>This header can be used on the file or folder shared, as well as on any files<br>or folders nested within the item.|
|version|query|string|false|The file version to download.|
|access_token|query|string|false|An optional access token that can be used to pre-authenticate this request, which means that a download link can be shared with a browser or a third party service without them needing to know how to handle the authentication.<br>When using this parameter, please make sure that the access token is sufficiently scoped down to only allow read access to that file and no other files or folders.|

> Example responses

> default Response

```json
{
  "type": "error",
  "status": 400,
  "code": "item_name_invalid",
  "message": "Method Not Allowed",
  "context_info": {
    "message": "Something went wrong"
  },
  "help_url": "https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/permissions-and-errors/common-errors/",
  "request_id": "abcdef123456"
}
```

<h3 id="download-file-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the requested file if the client has the **follow<br>redirects** setting enabled to automatically<br>follow HTTP `3xx` responses as redirects. If not, the request<br>will return `302` instead.<br>For details, see<br>the [download file guide](https://developer.box.com/guides/downloads/file#download-url).|Inline|
|202|Accepted|If the file is not ready to be downloaded yet `Retry-After` header will<br>be returned indicating the time in seconds after which the file will<br>be available for the client to download.<br><br>This response can occur when the file was uploaded immediately before the<br>download request.|None|
|302|Found|If the file is available for download the response will include a<br>`Location` header for the file on `dl.boxcloud.com`.<br><br>The `dl.boxcloud.com` URL is not persistent and clients will need<br>to follow the redirect to actually download the file.|None|
|default|Default|An unexpected client error.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|202|Retry-After|integer||The time in seconds after which to retry the download.|
|302|Location|string|url|A pointer to the download URL.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2Security
</aside>
