A retention policy blocks permanent deletion of content
for a specified amount of time. Admins can apply policies to
specified folders, or an entire enterprise. A file version retention
is a  record for a retained file version. To use this feature,
you must  have the manage retention policies scope enabled for your
API key in your application management console.

**Note**:
File retention API is now **deprecated**.
To get information about files and file versions under retention,
see [files under retention](https://developer.box.com/reference/get-retention-policy-assignments-id-files-under-retention) or [file versions under retention](https://developer.box.com/reference/get-retention-policy-assignments-id-file-versions-under-retention) endpoints.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this file version retention.|
|type|string|false|none|The value will always be `file_version_retention`.|
|file_version|object|false|none|none|
|file|object|false|none|none|
|applied_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When this file version retention object was<br>created.|
|disposition_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention expires on this file<br>version retention.|
|winning_retention_policy|object|false|none|none|

A standard representation of a folder, as returned from any
folder API endpoints by default.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier that represent a folder.<br><br>The ID for any folder can be determined<br>by visiting a folder in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folders/123`<br>the `folder_id` is `123`.|
|etag|string \| null|false|none|The HTTP `etag` of this folder. This can be used within some API<br>endpoints in the `If-Match` and `If-None-Match` headers to only<br>perform changes on the folder if (no) changes have happened.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `folder`.|
|sequence_id|object|false|none|none|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the folder.|
|created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time when the folder was created. This value may<br>be `null` for some folders such as the root folder or the trash<br>folder.|
|modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time when the folder was last updated. This value may<br>be `null` for some folders such as the root folder or the trash<br>folder.|
|description|object|false|none|none|
|size|integer(int64)|false|none|The folder size in bytes.<br><br>Be careful parsing this integer as its<br>value can get very large.|
|path_collection|object|false|none|none|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|modified_by|object|false|none|none|
|trashed_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this folder was put in the trash.|
|purged_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this folder is expected to be purged<br>from the trash.|
|content_created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was originally<br>created.|
|content_modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was last updated.|
|owned_by|object|false|none|none|
|shared_link|object \| null|false|none|none|
|folder_upload_email|object \| null|false|none|The `folder_upload_email` parameter is not `null` if one of the following options is **true**:<br><br>  * The **Allow uploads to this folder via email** and the **Only allow email uploads from collaborators in this folder** are [enabled for a folder in the Admin Console](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043697534-Upload-to-Box-Through-Email), and the user has at least **Upload** permissions granted.<br><br>  * The **Allow uploads to this folder via email** setting is enabled for a folder in the Admin Console, and the **Only allow email uploads from collaborators in this folder** setting is deactivated (unchecked).<br><br>If the conditions are not met, the parameter will have the following value: `folder_upload_email: null`.|
|parent|object \| null|false|none|none|
|item_status|string|false|none|Defines if this item has been deleted or not.<br><br>* `active` when the item has is not in the trash<br>* `trashed` when the item has been moved to the trash but not deleted<br>* `deleted` when the item has been permanently deleted.|
|item_collection|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|folder|
|item_status|active|
|item_status|trashed|
|item_status|deleted|

A full representation of a folder, as can be returned from any
folder API endpoints by default.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier that represent a folder.<br><br>The ID for any folder can be determined<br>by visiting a folder in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folders/123`<br>the `folder_id` is `123`.|
|etag|string \| null|false|none|The HTTP `etag` of this folder. This can be used within some API<br>endpoints in the `If-Match` and `If-None-Match` headers to only<br>perform changes on the folder if (no) changes have happened.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `folder`.|
|sequence_id|object|false|none|none|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the folder.|
|created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time when the folder was created. This value may<br>be `null` for some folders such as the root folder or the trash<br>folder.|
|modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time when the folder was last updated. This value may<br>be `null` for some folders such as the root folder or the trash<br>folder.|
|description|object|false|none|none|
|size|integer(int64)|false|none|The folder size in bytes.<br><br>Be careful parsing this integer as its<br>value can get very large.|
|path_collection|object|false|none|none|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|modified_by|object|false|none|none|
|trashed_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this folder was put in the trash.|
|purged_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this folder is expected to be purged<br>from the trash.|
|content_created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was originally<br>created.|
|content_modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was last updated.|
|owned_by|object|false|none|none|
|shared_link|object \| null|false|none|none|
|folder_upload_email|object \| null|false|none|The `folder_upload_email` parameter is not `null` if one of the following options is **true**:<br><br>  * The **Allow uploads to this folder via email** and the **Only allow email uploads from collaborators in this folder** are [enabled for a folder in the Admin Console](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043697534-Upload-to-Box-Through-Email), and the user has at least **Upload** permissions granted.<br><br>  * The **Allow uploads to this folder via email** setting is enabled for a folder in the Admin Console, and the **Only allow email uploads from collaborators in this folder** setting is deactivated (unchecked).<br><br>If the conditions are not met, the parameter will have the following value: `folder_upload_email: null`.|
|parent|object \| null|false|none|none|
|item_status|string|false|none|Defines if this item has been deleted or not.<br><br>* `active` when the item has is not in the trash<br>* `trashed` when the item has been moved to the trash but not deleted<br>* `deleted` when the item has been permanently deleted.|
|item_collection|object|false|none|none|
|sync_state|object|false|none|none|
|has_collaborations|boolean|false|none|Specifies if this folder has any other collaborators.|
|permissions|object|false|none|none|
|tags|object|false|none|none|
|can_non_owners_invite|object|false|none|none|
|is_externally_owned|boolean|false|none|Specifies if this folder is owned by a user outside of the<br>authenticated enterprise.|
|metadata|object|false|none|none|
|is_collaboration_restricted_to_enterprise|object|false|none|none|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|[string]|false|none|The shared link access levels the authenticated user is allowed to<br>use when creating or updating a shared link for this folder.<br><br>The list depends on item policy and user authorization. For some<br>folders, like the root folder, this is always empty as sharing is<br>not allowed at that level.|
|allowed_invitee_roles|[string]|false|none|A list of the types of roles that user can be invited at<br>when sharing this folder.|
|watermark_info|object|false|none|none|
|is_accessible_via_shared_link|boolean|false|none|Specifies if the folder can be accessed<br>with the direct shared link or a shared link<br>to a parent folder.|
|can_non_owners_view_collaborators|boolean|false|none|Specifies if collaborators who are not owners<br>of this folder are restricted from viewing other<br>collaborations on this folder.<br><br>It also restricts non-owners from inviting new<br>collaborators.|
|classification|object|false|none|none|
|is_associated_with_app_item|boolean|false|none|This field will return true if the folder or any ancestor of the<br>folder is associated with at least one app item. Note that this will<br>return true even if the context user does not have access to the<br>app item(s) associated with the folder.|
|collections|[[Collection](#schemacollection)]|false|none|The collections that this folder belongs to.<br><br>For more information, see the<br>[collections guide](https://developer.box.com/guides/collections).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|folder|
|item_status|active|
|item_status|trashed|
|item_status|deleted|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|open|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|company|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|collaborators|
|allowed_invitee_roles|editor|
|allowed_invitee_roles|viewer|
|allowed_invitee_roles|previewer|
|allowed_invitee_roles|uploader|

|allowed_invitee_roles|viewer uploader|
|allowed_invitee_roles|co-owner|

Folder locks define access restrictions placed by folder owners
to prevent specific folders from being moved or deleted.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|folder|object|false|none|none|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this folder lock.|
|type|string|false|none|The object type, always `folder_lock`.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the folder lock object was created.|
|locked_operations|object|false|none|The operations that have been locked. Currently the `move`<br>and `delete` operations cannot be locked separately, and both need to be<br>set to `true`.|
|lock_type|string|false|none|The lock type, always `freeze`.|

```json
  "description": "Support Group - as imported from Active Directory",
  "invitability_level": "admins_only",
  "member_viewability_level": "admins_only",
  "permissions": {
    "can_invite_as_collaborator": true
  }
}
```

Groups contain a set of users, and can be used in place of
users in some operations, such as collaborations.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for this object.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `group`.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the group.|
|group_type|string|false|none|The type of the group.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the group object was created.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the group object was last modified.|
|provenance|string|false|none|Keeps track of which external source this group is<br>coming from (e.g. "Active Directory", "Google Groups",<br>"Facebook Groups").  Setting this will<br>also prevent Box users from editing the group name<br>and its members directly via the Box web application.<br>This is desirable for one-way syncing of groups.|
|external_sync_identifier|string|false|none|An arbitrary identifier that can be used by<br>external group sync tools to link this Box Group to<br>an external group. Example values of this field<br>could be an Active Directory Object ID or a Google<br>Group ID.  We recommend you use of this field in<br>order to avoid issues when group names are updated in<br>either Box or external systems.|
|description|string|false|none|Human readable description of the group.|
|invitability_level|string|false|none|Specifies who can invite the group to collaborate<br>on items.<br><br>When set to `admins_only` the enterprise admin, co-admins,<br>and the group's admin can invite the group.<br><br>When set to `admins_and_members` all the admins listed<br>above and group members can invite the group.<br><br>When set to `all_managed_users` all managed users in the<br>enterprise can invite the group.|
|member_viewability_level|string|false|none|Specifies who can view the members of the group<br>(Get Memberships for Group).<br><br>* `admins_only` - the enterprise admin, co-admins, group's<br>  group admin.<br>* `admins_and_members` - all admins and group members.<br>* `all_managed_users` - all managed users in the<br>  enterprise.|
|permissions|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|group|
|group_type|managed_group|
|group_type|all_users_group|
|invitability_level|admins_only|
|invitability_level|admins_and_members|
|invitability_level|all_managed_users|
|member_viewability_level|admins_only|
|member_viewability_level|admins_and_members|
|member_viewability_level|all_managed_users|

An invite for a user to an enterprise.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for this invite.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `invite`.|
|invited_to|object|false|none|A representation of a Box enterprise.|
|actionable_by|[User--Mini](#schemauser--mini)|false|none|A mini representation of a user, as can be returned when nested within other<br>resources.|
|invited_by|[User--Mini](#schemauser--mini)|false|none|A mini representation of a user, as can be returned when nested within other<br>resources.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the invite.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the invite was created.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the invite was modified.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|invite|

An item represents a file, folder, or web link.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[File--Full](#schemafile--full)|false|none|A full representation of a file, as can be returned from any<br>file API endpoints by default.|
|*oneOf*|[Folder--Mini](#schemafolder--mini)|false|none|A mini representation of a file version, used when<br>nested under another resource.|
|*oneOf*|[WebLink](#schemaweblink)|false|none|Web links are objects that point to URLs. These objects<br>are also known as bookmarks within the Box web application.<br><br>Web link objects are treated similarly to file objects,<br>they will also support most actions that apply to regular files.|

A list of files, folders, and web links in
their mini representation.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|integer(int64)|false|none|The limit that was used for these entries. This will be the same as the<br>`limit` query parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value<br>allowed. The maximum value varies by API.|
|next_marker|string \| null|false|none|The marker for the start of the next page of results.|
|prev_marker|string \| null|false|none|The marker for the start of the previous page of results.|
|total_count|integer(int64)|false|none|One greater than the offset of the last entry in the entire collection.<br>The total number of entries in the collection may be less than<br>`total_count`.<br><br>This field is only returned for calls that use offset-based pagination.<br>For marker-based paginated APIs, this field will be omitted.|
|limit|integer(int64)|false|none|The limit that was used for these entries. This will be the same as the<br>`limit` query parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value<br>allowed. The maximum value varies by API.|
|offset|integer(int64)|false|none|The 0-based offset of the first entry in this set. This will be the same<br>as the `offset` query parameter.<br><br>This field is only returned for calls that use offset-based pagination.<br>For marker-based paginated APIs, this field will be omitted.|
|order|[object]|false|none|The order by which items are returned.<br><br>This field is only returned for calls that use offset-based pagination.<br>For marker-based paginated APIs, this field will be omitted.|
|entries|[[Item](#schemaitem)]|false|none|The items in this collection.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetadataCascadePolicy">MetadataCascadePolicy</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametadatacascadepolicy"></a>
<a id="schema_MetadataCascadePolicy"></a>
<a id="tocSmetadatacascadepolicy"></a>
<a id="tocsmetadatacascadepolicy"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "6fd4ff89-8fc1-42cf-8b29-1890dedd26d7",
  "type": "metadata_cascade_policy",
  "owner_enterprise": {
    "type": "enterprise",
    "id": "690678"
  },
  "parent": {
    "type": "folder",
    "id": "1234567"
  },
  "scope": "enterprise_123456",
  "templateKey": "productInfo"
}
```

A metadata cascade policy automatically applies a metadata template instance
to all the files and folders within the targeted folder.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The ID of the metadata cascade policy object.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `metadata_cascade_policy`.|
|owner_enterprise|object|false|none|The enterprise that owns this policy.|
|parent|object|false|none|Represent the folder the policy is applied to.|
|scope|string|false|none|The scope of the metadata cascade policy can either be `global` or<br>`enterprise_*`. The `global` scope is used for policies that are<br>available to any Box enterprise. The `enterprise_*` scope represents<br>policies that have been created within a specific enterprise, where `*`<br>will be the ID of that enterprise.|
|templateKey|string|false|none|The key of the template that is cascaded down to the folder's<br>children.<br><br>In many cases the template key is automatically derived<br>of its display name, for example `Contract Template` would<br>become `contractTemplate`. In some cases the creator of the<br>template will have provided its own template key.<br><br>Please [list the templates for an enterprise][list], or<br>get all instances on a [file][file] or [folder][folder]<br>to inspect a template's key.<br><br>[list]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-metadata-templates-enterprise<br>[file]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-metadata<br>[folder]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-metadata|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|metadata_cascade_policy|

Specifies which `date` field on the template to filter the search
results by, specifying a range of dates that can match.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lt|string(date-time)|false|none|Specifies the (inclusive) upper bound for the metadata field<br>value. The value of a field must be lower than (`lt`) or<br>equal to this value for the search query to match this<br>template.|
|gt|string(date-time)|false|none|Specifies the (inclusive) lower bound for the metadata field<br>value. The value of a field must be greater than (`gt`) or<br>equal to this value for the search query to match this<br>template.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetadataFilter">MetadataFilter</h2>

```json
  "templateKey": "contract",
  "filters": {
    "category": "online"
  }
}
```

A metadata template used to filter the search results.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|scope|string|false|none|Specifies the scope of the template to filter search results by.<br><br>This will be `enterprise_{enterprise_id}` for templates defined<br>for use in this enterprise, and `global` for general templates<br>that are available to all enterprises using Box.|
|templateKey|string|false|none|The key of the template used to filter search results.<br><br>In many cases the template key is automatically derived<br>of its display name, for example `Contract Template` would<br>become `contractTemplate`. In some cases the creator of the<br>template will have provided its own template key.<br><br>Please [list the templates for an enterprise][list], or<br>get all instances on a [file][file] or [folder][folder]<br>to inspect a template's key.<br><br>[list]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-metadata-templates-enterprise<br>[file]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-metadata<br>[folder]: https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-metadata|
|filters|object|false|none|Specifies which fields on the template to filter the search<br>results by. When more than one field is specified, the query<br>performs a logical `AND` to ensure that the instance of the<br>template matches each of the fields specified.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|scope|global|
|scope|enterprise|
|scope|enterprise_{enterprise_id}|


The value to be set or tested.

Required for `add`, `replace`, and `test` operations. For `add`,
if the value exists already the previous value will be overwritten
by the new value. For `replace`, the value must exist before
replacing.

For `test`, the existing value at the `path` location must match
the specified value.

|*oneOf*|string|false|none|none|

|*oneOf*|[string]|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_MetadataQuery">MetadataQuery</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametadataquery"></a>
<a id="schema_MetadataQuery"></a>
<a id="tocSmetadataquery"></a>
<a id="tocsmetadataquery"></a>

```json
{
  "from": "enterprise_123456.someTemplate",
  "query": "value >= :amount",
  "query_params": {
    "amount": "100"
  },
  "ancestor_folder_id": "0",
  "order_by": [
    {
      "field_key": "amount",
      "direction": "asc"
    }
  ],
  "limit": 50,
  "marker": "AAAAAmVYB1FWec8GH6yWu2nwmanfMh07IyYInaa7DZDYjgO1H4KoLW29vPlLY173OKsci6h6xGh61gG73gnaxoS+o0BbI1/h6le6cikjlupVhASwJ2Cj0tOD9wlnrUMHHw3/ISf+uuACzrOMhN6d5fYrbidPzS6MdhJOejuYlvsg4tcBYzjauP3+VU51p77HFAIuObnJT0ff",
  "fields": [
    "extension",
    "created_at",
    "item_status",
    "metadata.enterprise_1234.contracts",
    "metadata.enterprise_1234.regions.location"
  ]
}
```

Create a search using SQL-like syntax to return items that match specific
metadata.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string|true|none|Specifies the template used in the query. Must be in the form<br>`scope.templateKey`. Not all templates can be used in this field,<br>most notably the built-in, Box-provided classification templates<br>can not be used in a query.|
|query|string|false|none|The query to perform. A query is a logical expression that is very similar<br>to a SQL `SELECT` statement. Values in the search query can be turned into<br>parameters specified in the `query_param` arguments list to prevent having<br>to manually insert search values into the query string.<br><br>For example, a value of `:amount` would represent the `amount` value in<br>`query_params` object.|
|query_params|object|false|none|Set of arguments corresponding to the parameters specified in the<br>`query`. The type of each parameter used in the `query_params` must match<br>the type of the corresponding metadata template field.|
|ancestor_folder_id|string|true|none|The ID of the folder that you are restricting the query to. A<br>value of zero will return results from all folders you have access<br>to. A non-zero value will only return results found in the folder<br>corresponding to the ID or in any of its subfolders.|
|order_by|[object]|false|none|A list of template fields and directions to sort the metadata query<br>results by.<br><br>The ordering `direction` must be the same for each item in the array.|
|limit|integer|false|none|A value between 0 and 100 that indicates the maximum number of results<br>to return for a single request. This only specifies a maximum<br>boundary and will not guarantee the minimum number of results<br>returned.|
|marker|string|false|none|Marker to use for requesting the next page.|
|fields|[string]|false|none|By default, this endpoint returns only the most basic info about the items for<br>which the query matches. This attribute can be used to specify a list of<br>additional attributes to return for any item, including its metadata.<br><br>This attribute takes a list of item fields, metadata template identifiers,<br>or metadata template field identifiers.<br><br>For example:<br><br>* `created_by` will add the details of the user who created the item to<br>the response.<br>* `metadata.<scope>.<templateKey>` will return the mini-representation<br>of the metadata instance identified by the `scope` and `templateKey`.<br>* `metadata.<scope>.<templateKey>.<field>` will return all the mini-representation<br>of the metadata instance identified by the `scope` and `templateKey` plus<br>the field specified by the `field` name. Multiple fields for the same<br>`scope` and `templateKey` can be defined.|

```json
    }
  ],
  "copyInstanceOnItemCopy": true
}
```

A template for metadata that can be applied to files and folders.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The ID of the metadata template.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `metadata_template`.|
|scope|string|false|none|The scope of the metadata template can either be `global` or<br>`enterprise_*`. The `global` scope is used for templates that are<br>available to any Box enterprise. The `enterprise_*` scope represents<br>templates that have been created within a specific enterprise, where `*`<br>will be the ID of that enterprise.|
|templateKey|string|false|none|A unique identifier for the template. This identifier is unique across<br>the `scope` of the enterprise to which the metadata template is being<br>applied, yet is not necessarily unique across different enterprises.|
|displayName|string|false|none|The display name of the template. This can be seen in the Box web app<br>and mobile apps.|
|hidden|boolean|false|none|Defines if this template is visible in the Box web app UI, or if<br>it is purely intended for usage through the API.|
|fields|[object]|false|none|An ordered list of template fields which are part of the template. Each<br>field can be a regular text field, date field, number field, as well as a<br>single or multi-select list.|
|copyInstanceOnItemCopy|boolean|false|none|Whether or not to include the metadata when a file or folder is copied.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|metadata_template|

```json
  "actor_token": "c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ",
  "actor_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token",
  "scope": "item_upload item_preview base_explorer",
  "resource": "https://api.box.com/2.0/files/123456",
  "box_subject_type": "enterprise",
  "box_subject_id": "123456789",
  "box_shared_link": "https://cloud.box.com/s/123456"
}
```

A request for a new OAuth 2.0 token.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|grant_type|string(urn)|true|none|The type of request being made, either using a client-side obtained<br>authorization code, a refresh token, a JWT assertion, client credentials<br>grant or another access token for the purpose of downscoping a token.|
|client_id|string|false|none|The Client ID of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|client_secret|string|false|none|The client secret of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|code|string(token)|false|none|The client-side authorization code passed to your application by<br>Box in the browser redirect after the user has successfully<br>granted your application permission to make API calls on their<br>behalf.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code` as the `grant_type`.|
|refresh_token|string(token)|false|none|A refresh token used to get a new access token with.<br><br>Used in combination with `refresh_token` as the `grant_type`.|
|assertion|string(jwt)|false|none|A JWT assertion for which to request a new access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|subject_token|string(token)|false|none|The token to exchange for a downscoped token. This can be a regular<br>access token, a JWT assertion, or an app token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|subject_token_type|string|false|none|The type of `subject_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|actor_token|string(token)|false|none|The token used to create an annotator token.<br>This is a JWT assertion.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|actor_token_type|string(urn)|false|none|The type of `actor_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|scope|string(space_delimited_list)|false|none|The space-delimited list of scopes that you want apply to the<br>new access token.<br><br>The `subject_token` will need to have all of these scopes or<br>the call will error with **401 Unauthorized**..|
|resource|string(url)|false|none|Full URL for the file that the token should be generated for.|
|box_subject_type|string|false|none|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.|
|box_subject_id|string|false|none|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.<br>Value is determined by `box_subject_type`. If `user` use user ID and if<br>`enterprise` use enterprise ID.|
|box_shared_link|string(url)|false|none|Full URL of the shared link on the file or folder<br>that the token should be generated for.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|grant_type|authorization_code|
|grant_type|refresh_token|
|grant_type|client_credentials|
|grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer|
|grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange|
|subject_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token|
|actor_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token|
|box_subject_type|enterprise|
|box_subject_type|user|

A request to refresh an Access Token. Use this API to refresh an expired
Access Token using a valid Refresh Token.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|grant_type|string(urn)|true|none|The type of request being made, in this case a refresh request.|
|client_id|string|true|none|The client ID of the application requesting to refresh the token.|
|client_secret|string|true|none|The client secret of the application requesting to refresh the token.|
|refresh_token|string(token)|true|none|The refresh token to refresh.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|grant_type|refresh_token|

<h2 id="tocS_RealtimeServer">RealtimeServer</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarealtimeserver"></a>
<a id="schema_RealtimeServer"></a>
<a id="tocSrealtimeserver"></a>
<a id="tocsrealtimeserver"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "realtime_server",
  "url": "http://2.realtime.services.box.net/subscribe?channel=cc807c9c4869ffb1c81a&stream_type=all",
  "ttl": "10",
  "max_retries": "10",
  "retry_timeout": 610
}
```

A real-time server that can be used for
long polling user events.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|false|none|The value will always be `realtime_server`.|
|url|string|false|none|The URL for the server.|
|ttl|string|false|none|The time in minutes for which this server is available.|
|max_retries|string|false|none|The maximum number of retries this server will<br>allow before a new long poll should be started by<br>getting a [new list of server](https://developer.box.com/reference/options-events).|
|retry_timeout|integer|false|none|The maximum number of seconds without a response<br>after which you should retry the long poll connection.<br><br>This helps to overcome network issues where the long<br>poll looks to be working but no packages are coming<br>through.|

```json
      "retry_timeout": 610
    }
  ]
}
```

be used for long-polling.

|entries|[[RealtimeServer](#schemarealtimeserver)]|false|none|A list of real-time servers.|

```json
{
```

```json
  "type": "retention_policy",

  "retention_length": "365",
  "disposition_action": "permanently_delete",
  "max_extension_length": "365",
  "description": "Policy to retain all reports for at least one month",
  "policy_type": "finite",

  "status": "active",

  },

    }
  ],

    "enterprise": 1,
    "folder": 1,
    "metadata_template": 1
  }
```


A retention policy blocks permanent deletion of content
for a specified amount of time. Admins can create retention
policies and then later assign them to specific folders, metadata
templates, or their entire enterprise.  To use this feature, you must
have the manage retention policies scope enabled
for your API key via your application management console.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier that represents a retention policy.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `retention_policy`.|
|policy_name|string|false|none|The name given to the retention policy.|
|retention_length|string(int32)|false|none|The length of the retention policy. This value<br>specifies the duration in days that the retention<br>policy will be active for after being assigned to<br>content.  If the policy has a `policy_type` of<br>`indefinite`, the `retention_length` will also be<br>`indefinite`.|
|disposition_action|string|false|none|The disposition action of the retention policy.<br>This action can be `permanently_delete`, which<br>will cause the content retained by the policy<br>to be permanently deleted, or `remove_retention`,<br>which will lift the retention policy from the content,<br>allowing it to be deleted by users,<br>once the retention policy has expired.|
|max_extension_length|[RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthResponse](#schemaretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthresponse)|false|none|The maximum extension length of the retention date.<br>This value specifies the duration in days for which<br>the retention date of the file under policy can be extended.<br>If the policy type is other than 'finite' or<br>the disposition action is other than 'permanently delete',<br>or the maximum extension length is undefined,<br>this field will be set to 'none'.|
|description|string|false|none|The additional text description of the retention policy.|
|policy_type|string|false|none|The type of the retention policy. A retention<br>policy type can either be `finite`, where a<br>specific amount of time to retain the content is known<br>upfront, or `indefinite`, where the amount of time<br>to retain the content is still unknown.|
|retention_type|string|false|none|Specifies the retention type:<br><br>* `modifiable`: You can modify the retention policy. For example,<br> you can add or remove folders, shorten or lengthen<br> the policy duration, or delete the assignment.<br> Use this type if your retention policy<br> is not related to any regulatory purposes.<br><br>* `non-modifiable`: You can modify the retention policy<br> only in a limited way: add a folder, lengthen the duration,<br> retire the policy, change the disposition action<br> or notification settings. You cannot perform other actions,<br> such as deleting the assignment or shortening the<br> policy duration. Use this type to ensure<br> compliance with regulatory retention policies.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the retention policy. The status of<br>a policy will be `active`, unless explicitly retired by an<br>administrator, in which case the status will be `retired`.<br>Once a policy has been retired, it cannot become<br>active again.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention policy object was created.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention policy object was last modified.|
|can_owner_extend_retention|boolean|false|none|Determines if the owner of items under the policy<br>can extend the retention when the original<br>retention duration is about to end.|
|are_owners_notified|boolean|false|none|Determines if owners and co-owners of items<br>under the policy are notified when<br>the retention duration is about to end.|
|custom_notification_recipients|[[User--Mini](#schemauser--mini)]|false|none|A list of users notified when the retention policy duration is about to end.|
|assignment_counts|object|false|none|Counts the retention policy assignments for each item type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|retention_policy|
|disposition_action|permanently_delete|
|disposition_action|remove_retention|
|policy_type|finite|
|policy_type|indefinite|
|retention_type|modifiable|
|retention_type|non_modifiable|
|status|active|
|status|retired|

A retention assignment represents a rule specifying
the files a retention policy retains.
Assignments can retain files based on their folder or metadata,
or hold all files in the enterprise.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for a retention policy assignment.|

|retention_policy|object|false|none|none|
|assigned_to|object|false|none|The `type` and `id` of the content that is under<br>retention. The `type` can either be `folder`<br>`enterprise`, or `metadata_template`.|
|filter_fields|[object \| null]|false|none|An array of field objects. Values are only returned if the `assigned_to`<br>type is `metadata_template`. Otherwise, the array is blank.|
|assigned_by|object|false|none|none|
|assigned_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention policy assignment object was<br>created.|
|start_date_field|string|false|none|The date the retention policy assignment begins.<br>If the `assigned_to` type is `metadata_template`,<br>this field can be a date field's metadata attribute key id.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|entries|[[RetentionPolicyAssignment](#schemaretentionpolicyassignment)]|false|none|A list of retention policy assignments.|
|limit|integer(int64)|false|none|The limit that was used for these entries. This will be the same as the<br>`limit` query parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value<br>allowed. The maximum value varies by API.|
|next_marker|string \| null|false|none|The marker for the start of the next page of results.|

<h2 id="tocS_RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthRequest">RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthrequest"></a>
<a id="tocsretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthrequest"></a>

```json
"365"
```

The maximum extension length of the retention date.
This value specifies the duration in days for which
the retention date of the file under policy can be extended.
It can be specified only for the 'finite' policy type
where the disposition action is 'permanently delete',
otherwise the server will return status 400.
If this value is 'none', it won't be possible to extend
the retention.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|string|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|string(int32)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|integer(int32)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|*oneOf*|none|

<h2 id="tocS_RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthResponse">RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_RetentionPolicyMaxExtensionLengthResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsretentionpolicymaxextensionlengthresponse"></a>

```json
"365"
```

The maximum extension length of the retention date.
This value specifies the duration in days for which
the retention date of the file under policy can be extended.
If the policy type is other than 'finite' or
the disposition action is other than 'permanently delete',
or the maximum extension length is undefined,
this field will be set to 'none'.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|string|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|string(int32)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|*oneOf*|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[File--Full](#schemafile--full)|false|none|A full representation of a file, as can be returned from any<br>file API endpoints by default.|
|*oneOf*|[Folder--Full](#schemafolder--full)|false|none|A full representation of a folder, as can be returned from any<br>folder API endpoints by default.|
|*oneOf*|[WebLink](#schemaweblink)|false|none|Web links are objects that point to URLs. These objects<br>are also known as bookmarks within the Box web application.<br><br>Web link objects are treated similarly to file objects,<br>they will also support most actions that apply to regular files.|

A list of files, folders and web links that matched the search query.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|total_count|integer(int64)|false|none|One greater than the offset of the last entry in the search results.<br>The total number of entries in the collection may be less than<br>`total_count`.|
|limit|integer(int64)|false|none|The limit that was used for this search. This will be the same as the<br>`limit` query parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value<br>allowed.|
|offset|integer(int64)|false|none|The 0-based offset of the first entry in this set. This will be the same<br>as the `offset` query parameter used.|
|type|string|true|none|Specifies the response as search result items without shared links.|
|entries|[[SearchResultItem](#schemasearchresultitem)]|false|none|The search results for the query provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|search_results_items|

A list of files, folders and web links that matched the search query,
including the additional information about any shared links through
which the item has been shared with the user.

This response format is only returned when the `include_recent_shared_links`
query parameter has been set to `true`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|total_count|integer(int64)|false|none|One greater than the offset of the last entry in the search results.<br>The total number of entries in the collection may be less than<br>`total_count`.|
|limit|integer(int64)|false|none|The limit that was used for this search. This will be the same as the<br>`limit` query parameter unless that value exceeded the maximum value<br>allowed.|
|offset|integer(int64)|false|none|The 0-based offset of the first entry in this set. This will be the same<br>as the `offset` query parameter used.|
|type|string|true|none|Specifies the response as search result items with shared links.|
|entries|[[SearchResultWithSharedLink](#schemasearchresultwithsharedlink)]|false|none|The search results for the query provided, including the<br>additional information about any shared links through<br>which the item has been shared with the user.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|search_results_with_shared_links|

either a specific email address or every email address that belongs to

|value|string|true|none|The value of the allowlist entry.<br><br>* For `email` entries, the full email address (must contain `@`).<br>* For `domain` entries, the bare domain (e.g. `example.com`).|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the allowlist entry was added.|
|created_by|object|true|none|none|

|Property|Value|

|type|domain|

<h2 id="tocS_SharedLinkOtpWritable">SharedLinkOtpWritable</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasharedlinkotpwritable"></a>
<a id="schema_SharedLinkOtpWritable"></a>
<a id="tocSsharedlinkotpwritable"></a>
<a id="tocssharedlinkotpwritable"></a>

```json
{
  "mode": "none"
}
```

One-time-passcode (OTP) settings for a shared link. When OTP enforcement
is enabled, anonymous users must verify their identity via a
one-time-passcode emailed to them before the shared link will grant
access.

OTP can only be used with shared links that have an `access` level of
`open`. Password protection and OTP cannot be enabled at the same time.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[SharedLinkOtpWritableNone](#schemasharedlinkotpwritablenone)|false|none|One-time-passcode (OTP) enforcement is turned off. The shared link is<br>accessible without any one-time-passcode verification.|
|*oneOf*|[SharedLinkOtpWritableOpen](#schemasharedlinkotpwritableopen)|false|none|Any anonymous recipient can request a one-time-passcode to any email<br>address and access the shared link after verifying it. Collaborators<br>and registered Box users access the link without being prompted.|
|*oneOf*|[SharedLinkOtpWritableAllowlist](#schemasharedlinkotpwritableallowlist)|false|none|Anonymous recipients can request a one-time-passcode only when they<br>enter an email that matches an entry on the `allowlist`.|

<h2 id="tocS_SharedLinkOtpWritableAllowlist">SharedLinkOtpWritableAllowlist</h2>

```json
{
  "mode": "allowlist",
  "allowlist": [
    {
      "type": "email",
      "value": "user@example.com"
    },
    {
      "type": "domain",
      "value": "example.com"
    }
  ]
}
```

Anonymous recipients can request a one-time-passcode only when they
enter an email that matches an entry on the `allowlist`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|mode|string|true|none|Set to `allowlist` to restrict OTP requests to emails matching an<br>entry on the `allowlist`.|
|allowlist|[[SharedLinkOtpAllowlistEntryWritable](#schemasharedlinkotpallowlistentrywritable)]|true|none|The list of email and domain entries that are permitted to access the<br>shared link when `mode` is `allowlist`. Anonymous users whose<br>email matches an entry can request and verify a one-time-passcode.<br><br>Providing this field replaces the entire existing allowlist; passing<br>an empty array clears all entries. Required when `mode` is `allowlist`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|allowlist|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|is_document_preparation_needed|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the sender should receive a `prepare_url` in the response to complete document preparation using the UI.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|When specified, the signature request will be redirected to this url when a document is signed.|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The uri that a signer will be redirected to after declining to sign a document.|
|are_text_signatures_enabled|boolean|false|none|Disables the usage of signatures generated by typing (text).|
|email_subject|string \| null|false|none|Subject of sign request email. This is cleaned by sign request. If this field is not passed, a default subject will be used.|
|email_message|string \| null|false|none|Message to include in sign request email. The field is cleaned through sanitization of specific characters. However, some html tags are allowed. Links included in the message are also converted to hyperlinks in the email. The message may contain the following html tags including `a`, `abbr`, `acronym`, `b`, `blockquote`, `code`, `em`, `i`, `ul`, `li`, `ol`, and `strong`. Be aware that when the text to html ratio is too high, the email may end up in spam filters. Custom styles on these tags are not allowed. If this field is not passed, a default message will be used.|
|are_reminders_enabled|boolean|false|none|Reminds signers to sign a document on day 3, 8, 13 and 18. Reminders are only sent to outstanding signers.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the signature request.|
|prefill_tags|[[SignRequestPrefillTag](#schemasignrequestprefilltag)]|false|none|When a document contains sign-related tags in the content, you can prefill them using this `prefill_tags` by referencing the 'id' of the tag as the `external_id` field of the prefill tag.|
|days_valid|integer \| null|false|none|Set the number of days after which the created signature request will automatically expire if not completed. By default, we do not apply any expiration date on signature requests, and the signature request does not expire.|
|external_id|string \| null|false|none|This can be used to reference an ID in an external system that the sign request is related to.|
|template_id|string \| null|false|none|When a signature request is created from a template this field will indicate the id of that template.|
|external_system_name|string \| null|false|none|Used as an optional system name to appear in the signature log next to the signers who have been assigned the `embed_url_external_id`.|
|request_flow|string \| null|false|none|The flow type of the sign request. Values can include `standard` or `cfr11`.<br>When not specified during creation, a default is chosen based on admin settings.|
|type|string|false|none|The value will always be `sign-request`.|
|source_files|[[File--Base](#schemafile--base)]|false|none|List of files to create a signing document from. This is currently limited to ten files. Only the ID and type fields are required for each file.|
|signers|[[SignRequestSigner](#schemasignrequestsigner)]|false|none|Array of signers for the signature request.|
|signature_color|string \| null|false|none|Force a specific color for the signature (blue, black, or red).|
|id|string|false|none|Box Sign request ID.|
|prepare_url|string \| null|false|none|This URL is returned if `is_document_preparation_needed` is<br>set to `true` in the request. The parameter is used to prepare<br>the signature request<br>using the UI. The signature request is not<br>sent until the preparation<br>phase is complete.|
|signing_log|object|false|none|none|
|status|string|false|none|Describes the status of the signature request.|
|sign_files|object|false|none|List of files that will be signed, which are copies of the original<br>source files. A new version of these files are created as signers sign<br>and can be downloaded at any point in the signing process.|
|auto_expire_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Uses `days_valid` to calculate the date and time, in GMT, the sign request will expire if unsigned.|
|parent_folder|object|false|none|none|
|collaborator_level|string \| null|false|none|The collaborator level of the user to the sign request. Values can include "owner", "editor", and "viewer".|
|short_id|string|false|none|Short identifier for the sign request.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Timestamp marking when the sign request was created.|
|finished_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp indicating when all signing actions completed.|
|error_code|string \| null|false|read-only|When the sign request is in an error state, identifies the specific<br>reason. Null when no error code applies.|
|sender_email|string \| null|false|none|The email address of the sender of the sign request.|
|sender_id|integer \| null|false|none|The user ID of the sender of the sign request.|

A standard representation of a signature request object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|is_document_preparation_needed|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the sender should receive a `prepare_url` in the response to complete document preparation using the UI.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|When specified, the signature request will be redirected to this url when a document is signed.|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The uri that a signer will be redirected to after declining to sign a document.|
|are_text_signatures_enabled|boolean|false|none|Disables the usage of signatures generated by typing (text).|
|email_subject|string \| null|false|none|Subject of sign request email. This is cleaned by sign request. If this field is not passed, a default subject will be used.|
|email_message|string \| null|false|none|Message to include in sign request email. The field is cleaned through sanitization of specific characters. However, some html tags are allowed. Links included in the message are also converted to hyperlinks in the email. The message may contain the following html tags including `a`, `abbr`, `acronym`, `b`, `blockquote`, `code`, `em`, `i`, `ul`, `li`, `ol`, and `strong`. Be aware that when the text to html ratio is too high, the email may end up in spam filters. Custom styles on these tags are not allowed. If this field is not passed, a default message will be used.|
|are_reminders_enabled|boolean|false|none|Reminds signers to sign a document on day 3, 8, 13 and 18. Reminders are only sent to outstanding signers.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the signature request.|
|prefill_tags|[[SignRequestPrefillTag](#schemasignrequestprefilltag)]|false|none|When a document contains sign-related tags in the content, you can prefill them using this `prefill_tags` by referencing the 'id' of the tag as the `external_id` field of the prefill tag.|
|days_valid|integer \| null|false|none|Set the number of days after which the created signature request will automatically expire if not completed. By default, we do not apply any expiration date on signature requests, and the signature request does not expire.|
|external_id|string \| null|false|none|This can be used to reference an ID in an external system that the sign request is related to.|
|template_id|string \| null|false|none|When a signature request is created from a template this field will indicate the id of that template.|
|external_system_name|string \| null|false|none|Used as an optional system name to appear in the signature log next to the signers who have been assigned the `embed_url_external_id`.|
|request_flow|string \| null|false|none|The flow type of the sign request. Values can include `standard` or `cfr11`.<br>When not specified during creation, a default is chosen based on admin settings.|

The schema for a Signer object used in
for creating a Box Sign request object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|email|string \| null|false|none|Email address of the signer.<br>The email address of the signer is required when making signature requests, except when using templates that are configured to include emails.|
|role|string|false|none|Defines the role of the signer in the signature request. A `signer`<br>must sign the document and an `approver` must approve the document. A<br>`final_copy_reader` only receives the final signed document and signing<br>log.|
|is_in_person|boolean|false|none|Used in combination with an embed URL for a sender. After the<br>sender signs, they are redirected to the next `in_person` signer.|
|order|integer|false|none|Order of the signer.|
|embed_url_external_user_id|string \| null|false|none|User ID for the signer in an external application responsible<br>for authentication when accessing the embed URL.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirected<br>to after signing a document. Defining this URL<br>overrides default or global redirect URL<br>settings for a specific signer.<br>If no declined redirect URL is specified,<br>this URL will be used for decline actions as well.|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirect<br>to after declining to sign a document.<br>Defining this URL overrides default or global<br>declined redirect URL settings for a specific signer.|
|login_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to true, the signer will need to log in to a Box account<br>before signing the request. If the signer does not have<br>an existing account, they will have the option to create<br>a free Box account.|
|verification_phone_number|string \| null|false|none|If set, this phone number will be used to verify the signer<br>via two-factor authentication before they are able to sign the document.<br>Cannot be selected in combination with `login_required`.|
|password|string \| null|false|write-only|If set, the signer is required to enter the password before they are able<br>to sign a document. This field is write only.|
|signer_group_id|string \| null|false|none|If set, signers who have the same value will be assigned to the same input and to the same signer group.<br>A signer group is not a Box Group. It is an entity that belongs to a Sign Request and can only be<br>used/accessed within this Sign Request. A signer group is expected to have more than one signer.<br>If the provided value is only used for one signer, this value will be ignored and request will be handled<br>as it was intended for an individual signer. The value provided can be any string and only used to<br>determine which signers belongs to same group. A successful response will provide a generated UUID value<br>instead for signers in the same signer group.|
|suppress_notifications|boolean \| null|false|none|If true, no emails about the sign request will be sent.|
|language|string \| null|false|none|The language of the user, formatted in modified version of the<br>[ISO 639-1](https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/language-codes) format.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|role|signer|
|role|approver|
|role|final_copy_reader|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|email|string \| null|true|none|Email address of the signer.<br>The email address of the signer is required when making signature requests, except when using templates that are configured to include emails.|
|role|string|false|none|Defines the role of the signer in the signature request. A `signer`<br>must sign the document and an `approver` must approve the document. A<br>`final_copy_reader` only receives the final signed document and signing<br>log.|
|is_in_person|boolean|false|none|Used in combination with an embed URL for a sender. After the<br>sender signs, they are redirected to the next `in_person` signer.|
|order|integer|false|none|Order of the signer.|
|embed_url_external_user_id|string \| null|false|none|User ID for the signer in an external application responsible<br>for authentication when accessing the embed URL.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirected<br>to after signing a document. Defining this URL<br>overrides default or global redirect URL<br>settings for a specific signer.<br>If no declined redirect URL is specified,<br>this URL will be used for decline actions as well.|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirect<br>to after declining to sign a document.<br>Defining this URL overrides default or global<br>declined redirect URL settings for a specific signer.|
|login_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to true, the signer will need to log in to a Box account<br>before signing the request. If the signer does not have<br>an existing account, they will have the option to create<br>a free Box account.|
|verification_phone_number|string \| null|false|none|If set, this phone number will be used to verify the signer<br>via two-factor authentication before they are able to sign the document.<br>Cannot be selected in combination with `login_required`.|
|password|string \| null|false|write-only|If set, the signer is required to enter the password before they are able<br>to sign a document. This field is write only.|
|signer_group_id|string \| null|false|none|If set, signers who have the same value will be assigned to the same input and to the same signer group.<br>A signer group is not a Box Group. It is an entity that belongs to a Sign Request and can only be<br>used/accessed within this Sign Request. A signer group is expected to have more than one signer.<br>If the provided value is only used for one signer, this value will be ignored and request will be handled<br>as it was intended for an individual signer. The value provided can be any string and only used to<br>determine which signers belongs to same group. A successful response will provide a generated UUID value<br>instead for signers in the same signer group.|
|suppress_notifications|boolean \| null|false|none|If true, no emails about the sign request will be sent.|
|language|string \| null|false|none|The language of the user, formatted in modified version of the<br>[ISO 639-1](https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/language-codes) format.|
|has_viewed_document|boolean|false|read-only|Set to `true` if the signer views the document.|
|signer_decision|object \| null|false|none|Final decision made by the signer.|
|inputs|[[SignRequestSignerInput](#schemasignrequestsignerinput)]|false|read-only|none|
|embed_url|string \| null|false|read-only|URL to direct a signer to for signing.|
|iframeable_embed_url|string \| null|false|none|This URL is specifically designed for<br>signing documents within an HTML `iframe` tag.<br>It will be returned in the response<br>only if the `embed_url_external_user_id`<br>parameter was passed in the<br>`create Box Sign request` call.|
|attachments|[[SignRequestSignerAttachment](#schemasignrequestsignerattachment)]|false|none|Attachments that the signer uploaded.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|role|signer|
|role|approver|
|role|final_copy_reader|

A Box Sign template object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|false|none|The value will always be `sign-template`.|
|id|string|false|none|Template identifier.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|The name of the template.|
|email_subject|string \| null|false|none|Subject of signature request email. This is cleaned by sign<br>request. If this field is not passed, a default subject will be used.|
|email_message|string \| null|false|none|Message to include in signature request email. The field<br>is cleaned through sanitization of specific characters. However,<br>some html tags are allowed. Links included in the<br>message are also converted to hyperlinks in the email. The<br>message may contain the following html tags including `a`, `abbr`,<br>`acronym`, `b`, `blockquote`, `code`, `em`, `i`, `ul`, `li`, `ol`, and<br>`strong`. Be aware that when the text<br>to html ratio is too high, the email<br>may end up in spam filters. Custom styles on<br>these tags are not allowed.<br>If this field is not passed, a default message will be used.|
|days_valid|integer \| null|false|none|Set the number of days after which the<br>created signature request will automatically<br>expire if not completed. By default, we do<br>not apply any expiration date on signature<br>requests, and the signature request does not expire.|
|parent_folder|object|false|none|none|
|source_files|[[File--Mini](#schemafile--mini)]|false|none|List of files to create a signing document from.<br>Only the ID and type fields are required<br>for each file.|

|signers|[[TemplateSigner](#schematemplatesigner)]|false|none|Array of signers for the template.<br><br>**Note**: It may happen that some signers specified in the template belong to conflicting [segments](https://developer.box.com/reference/resources/shield-information-barrier-segment-member) (user groups).<br>This means that due to the security policies, users are assigned to segments to prevent exchanges or communication that could lead to ethical conflicts.<br>In such a case, an attempt to send a sign request based on a template that lists signers in conflicting segments will result in an error.<br><br>Read more about [segments and ethical walls](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/9920431507603-Understanding-Information-Barriers#h_01GFVJEHQA06N7XEZ4GCZ9GFAQ).|
|additional_info|object|false|none|Additional information on which fields are<br>required and which fields are not editable.|
|ready_sign_link|object \| null|false|none|Box's ready-sign link feature enables you to create a<br>link to a signature request that<br>you've created from a template. Use this link<br>when you want to post a signature request<br>on a public form — such as an email, social media post,<br>or web page — without knowing who the signers will be.<br>Note: The ready-sign link feature is<br>limited to Enterprise Plus customers and not<br>available to Box Verified Enterprises.|
|custom_branding|object \| null|false|none|Custom branding applied to notifications<br>and signature requests.|
|request_flow|string \| null|false|none|The sign flow of sign requests created from the template. Values can include `standard` or `cfr11`.|

A task allows for file-centric workflows within Box. Users can
create tasks on files and assign them to other users for them to complete the
tasks.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this task.|
|type|string|false|none|The value will always be `task`.|
|item|object|false|none|none|
|due_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the task is due.|
|action|string|false|none|The type of task the task assignee will be prompted to<br>perform.|
|message|string|false|none|A message that will be included with the task.|
|task_assignment_collection|object|false|none|none|
|is_completed|boolean|false|none|Whether the task has been completed.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the task object was created.|
|completion_rule|string|false|none|Defines which assignees need to complete this task before the task<br>is considered completed.<br><br>* `all_assignees` requires all assignees to review or<br>approve the task in order for it to be considered completed.<br>* `any_assignee` accepts any one assignee to review or<br>approve the task in order for it to be considered completed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|task|
|action|review|
|action|complete|
|completion_rule|all_assignees|
|completion_rule|any_assignee|

The schema for a Signer for Templates.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|inputs|[[TemplateSignerInput](#schematemplatesignerinput)]|false|read-only|none|
|email|string \| null|false|none|Email address of the signer.|
|role|string|false|none|Defines the role of the signer in the signature request. A role of<br>`signer` needs to sign the document, a role `approver`<br>approves the document and<br>a `final_copy_reader` role only<br>receives the final signed document and signing log.|
|is_in_person|boolean|false|none|Used in combination with an embed URL for a sender.<br>After the sender signs, they will be<br>redirected to the next `in_person` signer.|
|order|integer|false|none|Order of the signer.|
|signer_group_id|string \| null|false|none|If provided, this value points signers that are assigned the same inputs and belongs to same signer group.<br>A signer group is not a Box Group. It is an entity that belongs to the template itself and can only be used<br>within Box Sign requests created from it.|
|label|string \| null|false|none|A placeholder label for the signer set by the template creator to differentiate between signers.|
|public_id|string|false|none|An identifier for the signer. This can be used to identify a signer within the template.|
|is_password_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If true for signers with a defined email, the password provided when the template was created is used by default. <br>If true for signers without a specified / defined email, the creator needs to provide a password when using the template.|
|is_phone_number_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If true for signers with a defined email, the phone number provided when the template was created is used by default. <br>If true for signers without a specified / defined email, the template creator needs to provide a phone number when creating a request.|
|login_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If true, the signer is required to login to access the document.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|role|signer|
|role|approver|
|role|final_copy_reader|

Web links are objects that point to URLs. These objects
are also known as bookmarks within the Box web application.

Web link objects are treated similarly to file objects,
they will also support most actions that apply to regular files.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for this web link.|
|type|string|true|none|The value will always be `web_link`.|
|etag|string|false|none|The entity tag of this web link. Used with `If-Match`<br>headers.|
|url|string|false|none|The URL this web link points to.|
|sequence_id|object|false|none|none|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the web link.|
|parent|object|false|none|none|
|description|string|false|none|The description accompanying the web link. This is<br>visible within the Box web application.|
|path_collection|object|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When this file was created on Box’s servers.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When this file was last updated on the Box<br>servers.|
|trashed_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When this file was moved to the trash.|
|purged_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When this file will be permanently deleted.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|modified_by|object|false|none|none|
|owned_by|object|false|none|none|
|shared_link|object \| null|false|none|none|
|item_status|string|false|none|Whether this item is deleted or not. Values include `active`,<br>`trashed` if the file has been moved to the trash, and `deleted` if<br>the file has been permanently deleted.|
|collections|[[Collection](#schemacollection)]|false|none|The collections that this web link belongs to.<br><br>For more information, see the<br>[collections guide](https://developer.box.com/guides/collections).|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|[string]|false|none|The shared link access levels the authenticated user is allowed to<br>use when creating or updating a shared link for this web link.<br><br>The list depends on item policy and user authorization, so it may be<br>narrower than the levels available to the owner. An empty array means<br>no access level is available to this user.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|web_link|
|item_status|active|
|item_status|trashed|
|item_status|deleted|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|open|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|company|
|allowed_shared_link_access_levels|collaborators|

<h2 id="tocS_ZipDownload">ZipDownload</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemazipdownload"></a>
<a id="schema_ZipDownload"></a>
<a id="tocSzipdownload"></a>
<a id="tocszipdownload"></a>

```json
{
  "download_url": "https://dl.boxcloud.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/content",
  "status_url": "https://api.box.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/status",
  "expires_at": "2020-07-22T11:26:08Z",
  "name_conflicts": [
    [
      {
        "id": "12345",
        "type": "file",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "download_name": "3aa6a7.pdf"
      },
      {
        "id": "34325",
        "type": "file",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "download_name": "5d53f2.pdf"
      }
    ]
  ]
}
```

Represents a successful request to create a `zip` archive of a list of files
and folders.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|download_url|string|false|none|The URL that can be used to download the `zip` archive. A `Get` request to<br>this URL will start streaming the items requested. By default, this URL<br>is only valid for a few seconds, until the `expires_at` time, unless a<br>download is started after which it is valid for the duration of the<br>download.<br><br>It is important to note that the domain and path of this URL might change<br>between API calls, and therefore it's important to use this URL as-is.|
|status_url|string|false|none|The URL that can be used to get the status of the `zip` archive being<br>downloaded. A `Get` request to this URL will return the number of files<br>in the archive as well as the number of items already downloaded or<br>skipped. By default, this URL is only valid for a few seconds, until the<br>`expires_at` time, unless a download is started after which the URL is<br>valid for 12 hours from the start of the download.<br><br>It is important to note that the domain and path of this URL might change<br>between API calls, and therefore it's important to use this URL as-is.|
|expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The time and date when this archive will expire. After this time the<br>`status_url` and `download_url` will return an error.<br><br>By default, these URLs are only valid for a few seconds, unless a download<br>is started after which the `download_url` is valid for the duration of the<br>download, and the `status_url` is valid for 12 hours from the start of the<br>download.|
|name_conflicts|[[object]]|false|none|A list of conflicts that occurred when trying to create the archive. This<br>would occur when multiple items have been requested with the<br>same name.<br><br>To solve these conflicts, the API will automatically rename an item<br>and return a mapping between the original item's name and its new<br>name.<br><br>For every conflict, both files will be renamed and therefore this list<br>will always be a multiple of 2.|

<h2 id="tocS_ZipDownloadRequest">ZipDownloadRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemazipdownloadrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_ZipDownloadRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSzipdownloadrequest"></a>
<a id="tocszipdownloadrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "file",
      "id": "12345"
    }
  ],
  "download_file_name": "January Financials"
}
```

A request to create a `zip` archive to download.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|items|[object]|true|none|A list of items to add to the `zip` archive. These can<br>be folders or files.|
|download_file_name|string|false|none|The optional name of the `zip` archive. This name will be appended by the<br>`.zip` file extension, for example `January Financials.zip`.|

<h2 id="tocS_ZipDownloadStatus">ZipDownloadStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemazipdownloadstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_ZipDownloadStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSzipdownloadstatus"></a>
<a id="tocszipdownloadstatus"></a>

```json
{
  "total_file_count": 20,
  "downloaded_file_count": 10,
  "skipped_file_count": 5,
  "skipped_folder_count": 5,
  "state": "succeeded"
}
```

The status of a `zip` archive being downloaded.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|total_file_count|integer|false|none|The total number of files in the archive.|
|downloaded_file_count|integer|false|none|The number of files that have already been downloaded.|
|skipped_file_count|integer|false|none|The number of files that have been skipped as they could not be<br>downloaded. In many cases this is due to permission issues that have<br>surfaced between the creation of the request for the archive and the<br>archive being downloaded.|
|skipped_folder_count|integer|false|none|The number of folders that have been skipped as they could not be<br>downloaded. In many cases this is due to permission issues that have<br>surfaced between the creation of the request for the archive and the<br>archive being downloaded.|
|state|string|false|none|The state of the archive being downloaded.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|in_progress|
|state|failed|
|state|succeeded|
